|» » » backgroundSpeechDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|This enables filtering of noise and background speech while the user is talking.<br><br>Features:<br>- Smart denoising using Krisp<br>- Fourier denoising<br><br>Smart denoising can be combined with or used independently of Fourier denoising.<br><br>Order of precedence:<br>- Smart denoising<br>- Fourier denoising|
|» » » » smartDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » » fourierDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.<br><br>This can be combined with smart denoising, and will be run afterwards.|

|» » » » » mediaDetectionEnabled|body|boolean|false|Whether automatic media detection is enabled. When enabled, the filter will automatically<br>detect consistent background TV/music/radio and switch to more aggressive filtering settings.<br>Only applies when enabled is true.|
|» » » » » staticThreshold|body|number|false|Static threshold in dB used as fallback when no baseline is established.|
|» » » » » baselineOffsetDb|body|number|false|How far below the rolling baseline to filter audio, in dB.<br>Lower values (e.g., -10) are more aggressive, higher values (e.g., -20) are more conservative.|

|» » » » » baselinePercentile|body|number|false|Percentile to use for baseline calculation (1-99).<br>Higher percentiles (e.g., 85) focus on louder speech, lower percentiles (e.g., 50) include quieter speech.|

|» » » startSpeakingPlan|body|object|false|This is the plan for when the assistant should start talking.<br><br>You should configure this if you're running into these issues:<br>- The assistant is too slow to start talking after the customer is done speaking.<br>- The assistant is too fast to start talking after the customer is done speaking.<br>- The assistant is so fast that it's actually interrupting the customer.|

|» » » stopSpeakingPlan|body|object|false|This is the plan for when assistant should stop talking on customer interruption.<br><br>You should configure this if you're running into these issues:<br>- The assistant is too slow to recognize customer's interruption.<br>- The assistant is too fast to recognize customer's interruption.<br>- The assistant is getting interrupted by phrases that are just acknowledgments.<br>- The assistant is getting interrupted by background noises.<br>- The assistant is not properly stopping -- it starts talking right after getting interrupted.|
|» » » » numWords|body|number|false|This is the number of words that the customer has to say before the assistant will stop talking.<br><br>Words like "stop", "actually", "no", etc. will always interrupt immediately regardless of this value.<br><br>Words like "okay", "yeah", "right" will never interrupt.<br><br>When set to 0, `voiceSeconds` is used in addition to the transcriptions to determine the customer has started speaking.<br><br>Defaults to 0.<br><br>@default 0|
|» » » » voiceSeconds|body|number|false|This is the seconds customer has to speak before the assistant stops talking. |» » » » backoffSeconds|body|number|false|This is the seconds to wait before the assistant will start talking again after being interrupted.<br><br>Defaults to 1.<br><br>@default 1|

|» » » variableValues|body|object|false|These are values that will be used to replace the template variables in the assistant messages and other text-based fields.<br>This uses LiquidJS syntax. https://liquidjs.com/tutorials/intro-to-liquid.html<br><br>So for example, `{{ name }}` will be replaced with the value of `name` in `variableValues`.<br>`{{"now" \| date: "%b %d, %Y, %I:%M %p", "America/New_York"}}` will be replaced with the current date and time in New York.<br> Some VAPI reserved defaults:<br> - *customer* - the customer object|
|» » » name|body|string|false|This is the name of the assistant.<br><br>This is required when you want to transfer between assistants in a call.|
|» » » voicemailMessage|body|string|false|This is the message that the assistant will say if the call is forwarded to voicemail.<br><br>If unspecified, it will hang up.|
|» » » endCallMessage|body|string|false|This is the message that the assistant will say if it ends the call.<br><br>If unspecified, it will hang up without saying anything.|
|» » » endCallPhrases|body|[string]|false|This list contains phrases that, if spoken by the assistant, will trigger the call to be hung up. Case insensitive.|
|» » » compliancePlan|body|[CompliancePlan](#schemacomplianceplan)|false|none|
|» » » metadata|body|object|false|This is for metadata you want to store on the assistant.|
|» » » backgroundSpeechDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|This enables filtering of noise and background speech while the user is talking.<br><br>Features:<br>- Smart denoising using Krisp<br>- Fourier denoising<br><br>Smart denoising can be combined with or used independently of Fourier denoising.<br><br>Order of precedence:<br>- Smart denoising<br>- Fourier denoising|
|» » » » smartDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » » fourierDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.<br><br>This can be combined with smart denoising, and will be run afterwards.|
|» » » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.|
|» » » » » mediaDetectionEnabled|body|boolean|false|Whether automatic media detection is enabled. When enabled, the filter will automatically<br>detect consistent background TV/music/radio and switch to more aggressive filtering settings.<br>Only applies when enabled is true.|
|» » » » » staticThreshold|body|number|false|Static threshold in dB used as fallback when no baseline is established.|
|» » » » » baselineOffsetDb|body|number|false|How far below the rolling baseline to filter audio, in dB.<br>Lower values (e.g., -10) are more aggressive, higher values (e.g., -20) are more conservative.|
|» » » » » windowSizeMs|body|number|false|Rolling window size in milliseconds for calculating the audio baseline.<br>Larger windows adapt more slowly but are more stable.|
|» » » » » baselinePercentile|body|number|false|Percentile to use for baseline calculation (1-99).<br>Higher percentiles (e.g., 85) focus on louder speech, lower percentiles (e.g., 50) include quieter speech.|
|» » » analysisPlan|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** This is the plan for analysis of assistant's calls. Stored in `call.analysis`.|
|» » » » minMessagesThreshold|body|number|false|**Deprecated.** The minimum number of messages required to run the analysis plan.<br>If the number of messages is less than this, analysis will be skipped.<br><br>@default 2|

|» » » » » messages|body|[object]|false|These are the messages used to generate the summary.<br><br>@default: ```<br>[<br>  {<br>    "role": "system",<br>    "content": "You are an expert note-taker. You will be given a transcript of a call. Summarize the call in 2-3 sentences. DO NOT return anything except the summary."<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here is the transcript:\n\n{{transcript}}\n\n. Here is the ended reason of the call:\n\n{{endedReason}}\n\n"<br>  }<br>]```<br><br>You can customize by providing any messages you want.<br><br>Here are the template variables available:<br>- {{transcript}}: The transcript of the call from `call.artifact.transcript` <br>- {{systemPrompt}}: The system prompt of the call from `assistant.model.messages[type=system].content` <br>- {{messages}}: The messages of the call from `assistant.model.messages` <br>- {{endedReason}}: The ended reason of the call from `call.endedReason`|
|» » » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether a summary is generated and stored in `call.analysis.summary`. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to disable the summary, set this to false.<br><br>@default true|

The output is stored in `call.analysis.successEvaluation`.<br><br>Options include:<br>- 'NumericScale': A scale of 1 to 10.<br>- 'DescriptiveScale': A scale of Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor.<br>- 'Checklist': A checklist of criteria and their status.<br>- 'Matrix': A grid that evaluates multiple criteria across different performance levels.<br>- 'PercentageScale': A scale of 0% to 100%.<br>- 'LikertScale': A scale of Strongly Agree, Agree, Neutral, Disagree, Strongly Disagree.<br>- 'AutomaticRubric': Automatically break down evaluation into several criteria, each with its own score.<br>- 'PassFail': A simple 'true' if call passed, 'false' if not.<br><br>Default is 'PassFail'.|
|» » » » » messages|body|[object]|false|These are the messages used to generate the success evaluation.<br><br>@default: ```<br>[<br>  {<br>    "role": "system",<br>    "content": "You are an expert call evaluator. DO NOT return anything except the result.\n\nRubric:\\n{{rubric}}\n\nOnly respond with the result."<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here is the transcript:\n\n{{transcript}}\n\n"<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here was the system prompt of the call:\n\n{{systemPrompt}}\n\n. Here is the ended reason of the call:\n\n{{endedReason}}\n\n"<br>  }<br>]```<br><br>You can customize by providing any messages you want.<br><br>Here are the template variables available:<br>- {{transcript}}: the transcript of the call from `call.artifact.transcript`- {{systemPrompt}}: the system prompt of the call from `assistant.model.messages[type=system].content`- {{messages}}: the messages of the call from `assistant.model.messages`- {{rubric}}: the rubric of the success evaluation from `successEvaluationPlan.rubric`- {{endedReason}}: the ended reason of the call from `call.endedReason`|
|» » » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether a success evaluation is generated and stored in `call.analysis.successEvaluation`. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to disable the success evaluation, set this to false.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » » » timeoutSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long the request is tried before giving up. |» » » » recordingEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether assistant's calls are recorded. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you don't want to record the calls, set this to false.<br>- If you want to record the calls when `assistant.hipaaEnabled` (deprecated) or `assistant.compliancePlan.hipaaEnabled` explicity set this to true and make sure to provide S3 or GCP credentials on the Provider Credentials page in the Dashboard.<br><br>You can find the recording at `call.artifact.recordingUrl` and `call.artifact.stereoRecordingUrl` after the call is ended.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » » recordingFormat|body|string|false|This determines the format of the recording. Defaults to `wav;l16`.<br><br>@default 'wav;l16'|
|» » » » recordingUseCustomStorageEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether to use custom storage (S3 or GCP) for call recordings when storage credentials are configured.<br><br>When set to false, recordings will be stored on Vapi's storage instead of your custom storage, even if you have custom storage credentials configured.<br><br>Usage:<br>- Set to false if you have custom storage configured but want to store recordings on Vapi's storage for this assistant.<br>- Set to true (or leave unset) to use your custom storage for recordings when available.<br><br>If your organization has ZDR (zero data retention) or PCI enabled, recordings are never written to Vapi storage. In that case, false means "do not use my custom storage", so nothing is stored at all.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » » videoRecordingEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the video is recorded during the call. Defaults to false. Only relevant for `webCall` type.<br><br>You can find the video recording at `call.artifact.videoRecordingUrl` after the call is ended.<br><br>@default false|

This is only used if you have provided S3 or GCP credentials on the Provider Credentials page in the Dashboard.<br><br>If credential.s3PathPrefix or credential.bucketPlan.path is set, this will append to it.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to upload the call logs to a specific path, set this to the path. Example: `/my-assistant-logs`.<br>- If you want to upload the call logs to the root of the bucket, set this to `/`.<br><br>@default '/'|
|» » » startSpeakingPlan|body|object|false|This is the plan for when the assistant should start talking.<br><br>You should configure this if you're running into these issues:<br>- The assistant is too slow to start talking after the customer is done speaking.<br>- The assistant is too fast to start talking after the customer is done speaking.<br>- The assistant is so fast that it's actually interrupting the customer.|
|» » » » waitSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long assistant waits before speaking. Defaults to 0.4.<br><br>This is the minimum it will wait but if there is latency is the pipeline, this minimum will be exceeded. This is intended as a stopgap in case the pipeline is moving too fast.<br><br>Example:<br>- If model generates tokens and voice generates bytes within 100ms, the pipeline still waits 300ms before outputting speech.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If the customer is taking long pauses, set this to a higher value.<br>- If the assistant is accidentally jumping in too much, set this to a higher value.<br><br>@default 0.4|

|» » » » transcriptionEndpointingPlan|body|object|false|This determines how a customer speech is considered done (endpointing) using the transcription of customer's speech.<br><br>Once an endpoint is triggered, the request is sent to `assistant.model`.<br><br>Note: This plan is only used if `smartEndpointingPlan` is not set and transcriber does not have built-in endpointing capabilities. |» » » » » onPunctuationSeconds|body|number|false|The minimum number of seconds to wait after transcription ending with punctuation before sending a request to the model. Defaults to 0.1.<br><br>This setting exists because the transcriber punctuates the transcription when it's more confident that customer has completed a thought.<br><br>@default 0.1|
|» » » » » onNoPunctuationSeconds|body|number|false|The minimum number of seconds to wait after transcription ending without punctuation before sending a request to the model. Defaults to 1.5.<br><br>This setting exists to catch the cases where the transcriber was not confident enough to punctuate the transcription, but the customer is done and has been silent for a long time.<br><br>@default 1.5|
|» » » » » onNumberSeconds|body|number|false|The minimum number of seconds to wait after transcription ending with a number before sending a request to the model. Defaults to 0.4.<br><br>This setting exists because the transcriber will sometimes punctuate the transcription ending with a number, even though the customer hasn't uttered the full number. This happens commonly for long numbers when the customer reads the number in chunks.<br><br>@default 0.5|
|» » » stopSpeakingPlan|body|object|false|This is the plan for when assistant should stop talking on customer interruption.<br><br>You should configure this if you're running into these issues:<br>- The assistant is too slow to recognize customer's interruption.<br>- The assistant is too fast to recognize customer's interruption.<br>- The assistant is getting interrupted by phrases that are just acknowledgments.<br>- The assistant is getting interrupted by background noises.<br>- The assistant is not properly stopping -- it starts talking right after getting interrupted.|
|» » » » numWords|body|number|false|This is the number of words that the customer has to say before the assistant will stop talking.<br><br>Words like "stop", "actually", "no", etc. will always interrupt immediately regardless of this value.<br><br>Words like "okay", "yeah", "right" will never interrupt.<br><br>When set to 0, `voiceSeconds` is used in addition to the transcriptions to determine the customer has started speaking.<br><br>Defaults to 0.<br><br>@default 0|
|» » » » voiceSeconds|body|number|false|This is the seconds customer has to speak before the assistant stops talking. This uses the VAD (Voice Activity Detection) spike to determine if the customer has started speaking.<br><br>Considerations:<br>- A lower value might be more responsive but could potentially pick up non-speech sounds.<br>- A higher value reduces false positives but might slightly delay the detection of speech onset.<br><br>This is only used if `numWords` is set to 0.<br><br>Defaults to 0.2<br><br>@default 0.2|
|» » » » backoffSeconds|body|number|false|This is the seconds to wait before the assistant will start talking again after being interrupted.<br><br>Defaults to 1.<br><br>@default 1|
|» » » » acknowledgementPhrases|body|[string]|false|These are the phrases that will never interrupt the assistant, even if numWords threshold is met.<br>These are typically acknowledgement or backchanneling phrases.|

|» » » » listenEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the assistant's calls allow live listening. Defaults to true.<br><br>Fetch `call.monitor.listenUrl` to get the live listening URL.<br><br>@default true|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer
</aside>

## Get Session

<a id="opIdSessionController_findOne"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/session/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /session/{id}`

<h3 id="get-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier for the resource.|

## Delete Session

<a id="opIdSessionController_remove"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/session/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /session/{id}`

<h3 id="delete-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier for the resource.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer
</aside>

## Update Session

<a id="opIdSessionController_update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/session/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "status": "active",
    "expirationSeconds": 86400,
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "string",
        "message": "string",
        "time": 0,
        "secondsFromStart": 0
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PATCH /session/{id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "status": "active",
  "expirationSeconds": 86400,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "string",
      "message": "string",
      "time": 0,
      "secondsFromStart": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier for the resource.|
|body|body|[UpdateSessionDTO](#schemaupdatesessiondto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|This is the new name for the session. Maximum length is 40 characters.|
|» status|body|string|false|This is the new status for the session.|
|» expirationSeconds|body|number|false|Session expiration time in seconds. Defaults to 24 hours (86400 seconds) if not set.|
|» messages|body|[[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|false|This is the updated array of chat messages.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[UserMessage](#schemausermessage)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|active|
|» status|completed|

<h1 id="vapi-api-traffic-allocations">Traffic Allocations</h1>

## List traffic allocations

<a id="opIdTrafficAllocationController_findAllPaginated"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/traffic-allocations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /traffic-allocations`

The append-only history of an assistant's allocations, newest first.

<h3 id="list-traffic-allocations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantId|query|string|false|Filter to allocations for this assistant.|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number to return. Defaults to 1.|
|limit|query|integer|false|The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.|
|sortOrder|query|string|false|The sort order for pagination. Defaults to 'DESC'.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sortOrder|ASC|
|sortOrder|DESC|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "orgId": "string",
      "assistantId": "string",
      "allocationIntent": "follow-latest",
      "createdAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "actorType": "user",
      "actorId": "string",
      "actorEmail": "string",
      "description": "string",
      "targets": [
        {
          "assistantVersion": "string",
          "position": 0,
          "percentage": 0
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "itemsPerPage": 0,
    "totalItems": 0,
    "currentPage": 0,

    "hasNextPage": true,
    "nextCursor": "string",

    "itemsBeyondRetention": true,
    "createdAtLe": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "createdAtGe": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="list-traffic-allocations-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[TrafficAllocationPaginatedResponse](#schematrafficallocationpaginatedresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|Traffic splitting is not enabled for your organization. The feature is in beta, rolling out to select organizations.|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

## Create traffic allocation

<a id="opIdTrafficAllocationController_create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/traffic-allocations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "assistantId": "string",
    "allocationIntent": "follow-latest",
    "targets": [
      {
        "assistantVersion": "string",
        "percentage": 0
      }
    ],
    "expectedCurrentAllocationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "description": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /traffic-allocations`

Creates a new traffic allocation for an assistant, replacing the one currently in effect. To start or adjust a split, send targets naming published versions (such as "v7") with percentages totaling 100; allocationIntent is inferred as 'explicit'. To stop splitting and send every call to the newest published version, send allocationIntent 'follow-latest' with no targets field; stopping always names its intent, so a dropped targets field can never end a split by accident.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "assistantId": "string",
  "allocationIntent": "follow-latest",
  "targets": [
    {
      "assistantVersion": "string",
      "percentage": 0
    }
  ],
  "expectedCurrentAllocationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "description": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-traffic-allocation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateTrafficAllocationDTO](#schemacreatetrafficallocationdto)|true|none|
|» assistantId|body|string|true|The assistant whose calls this allocation splits.|
|» allocationIntent|body|string|false|'explicit' splits calls across targets, and is inferred when targets is sent. 'follow-latest' sends every call to the newest published version and is how you stop splitting; it must be sent explicitly.|
|» targets|body|[[CreateTrafficAllocationTargetDTO](#schemacreatetrafficallocationtargetdto)]|false|The versions to split calls across. Omit to stop splitting (with allocationIntent 'follow-latest'). Order in this array is the selection order (position).|
|» expectedCurrentAllocationId|body|string(uuid)|false|Optional concurrency guard. Omit it and the write applies unconditionally (last write wins, matching every other Vapi update surface). Provide the id of the allocation you last read and the write applies only while that allocation is still governing; any mismatch is a 409 carrying the actual current id.|
|» description|body|string|false|An optional note explaining why you made this change.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» allocationIntent|follow-latest|
|» allocationIntent|explicit|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "orgId": "string",
  "assistantId": "string",
  "allocationIntent": "follow-latest",
  "createdAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "actorType": "user",
  "actorId": "string",
  "actorEmail": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "targets": [
    {
      "assistantVersion": "string",
      "position": 0,
      "percentage": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

> 409 Response

```json
{
  "error": "stale_allocation",
  "message": "string",
  "currentAllocationId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

<h3 id="create-traffic-allocation-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created||[TrafficAllocation](#schematrafficallocation)|
|400|Bad Request|Create 400s when the request carries neither targets nor an allocationIntent, when the target set breaks a shape rule (targets combined with follow-latest, an explicit allocation with no targets, duplicate target versions, percentages not totaling 100, no positive percentage), or when a target names a version that does not exist on this assistant.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Traffic splitting is not enabled for your organization. The feature is in beta, rolling out to select organizations.|None|
|404|Not Found|The source assistant does not exist.|None|
|409|Conflict|The provided expectedCurrentAllocationId no longer matches the allocation currently in effect (see TrafficAllocationStaleConflictResponseDTO; omitting the field never conflicts), or Vapi for CX manages the assistant (see AssistantManagedConflictResponseDTO).|Inline|

<h3 id="create-traffic-allocation-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **409**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[TrafficAllocationStaleConflictResponseDTO](#schematrafficallocationstaleconflictresponsedto)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[AssistantManagedConflictResponseDTO](#schemaassistantmanagedconflictresponsedto)|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer
</aside>

## Get latest traffic allocation

<a id="opIdTrafficAllocationController_latestGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.vapi.ai/traffic-allocations/latest?assistantId=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /traffic-allocations/latest`

The allocation currently in effect for the assistant, with its targets. The response carries no allocation field when traffic splitting has never been configured.

```json
    "actorType": "user",
    "actorId": "string",
    "actorEmail": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "targets": [
      {
        "assistantVersion": "string",
        "position": 0,
        "percentage": 0
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|403|Forbidden|Traffic splitting is not enabled for your organization. The feature is in beta, rolling out to select organizations.|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

## Get traffic split metrics

<a id="opIdTrafficAllocationController_metricsGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.vapi.ai/traffic-allocations/metrics?assistantId=string&from=1970-01-01T00%3A00%3A00Z&to=1970-01-01T00%3A00%3A00Z' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /traffic-allocations/metrics`

Per-assistant-version call metrics over a time window: call counts, configured vs actual traffic share, duration, cost per minute, latency, ended reasons, a bucketed timeseries, and optional structured output aggregations. Calls with no assistant version are reported as an 'unversioned' row.

<h3 id="get-traffic-split-metrics-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantId|query|string|true|The assistant whose per-version traffic metrics to return.|
|from|query|string(date-time)|true|Start of the metrics window (inclusive), ISO 8601 datetime.|
|to|query|string(date-time)|true|End of the metrics window (exclusive), ISO 8601 datetime. Must be later than from, and the window may hold at most 2000 buckets of the requested width.|
|bucket|query|string|false|Bucket size for the timeseries. Defaults to 'day'.|
|structuredOutputIds|query|array|false|Structured output ids to aggregate per version, as an array or a comma-separated string. At most 5.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|bucket|hour|
|bucket|day|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
```

## Upload File

<a id="opIdFileController_create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/file \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'file=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'purpose=assistant' \
  -F 'metadata=string'
```

`POST /file`

> Body parameter

```yaml
file: string
purpose: assistant
```

## List Structured Outputs

<a id="opIdStructuredOutputController_findAll"></a>

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /structured-output`

<h3 id="list-structured-outputs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|query|string|false|This will return structured outputs where the id matches the specified value.|
|name|query|string|false|This will return structured outputs where the name matches the specified value.|
|page|query|number|false|This is the page number to return. Defaults to 1.|
|sortOrder|query|string|false|This is the sort order for pagination. Defaults to 'DESC'.|
|sortBy|query|string|false|This is the column to sort by. Defaults to 'createdAt'.|
|limit|query|number|false|This is the maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.|
|createdAtGt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than the specified value.|
|createdAtLt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is less than the specified value.|
|createdAtGe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|createdAtLe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtGt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than the specified value.|
|updatedAtLt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than the specified value.|
|updatedAtGe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtLe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|

<h3 id="run-structured-output-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[StructuredOutputRunDTO](#schemastructuredoutputrundto)|true|none|
|» previewEnabled|body|boolean|false|This is the preview flag for the re-run. If true, the re-run will be executed and the response will be returned immediately and the call artifact will NOT be updated.<br>If false (default), the re-run will be executed and the response will be updated in the call artifact.|
|» structuredOutputId|body|string|false|This is the ID of the structured output that will be run. This must be provided unless a transient structured output is provided.<br>When the re-run is executed, only the value of this structured output will be replaced with the new value, or added if not present.|
|» structuredOutput|body|object|false|This is the transient structured output that will be run. This must be provided if a structured output ID is not provided.<br>When the re-run is executed, the structured output value will be added to the existing artifact.|
|» » type|body|string|false|This is the type of structured output.<br><br>- 'ai': Uses an LLM to extract structured data from the conversation (default).<br>- 'regex': Uses a regex pattern to extract data from the transcript without an LLM.<br><br>Defaults to 'ai' if not specified.|
|» » regex|body|string|false|This is the regex pattern to match against the transcript.<br><br>Simulation evaluations use a canonical transcript built from recorded messages:<br>User: and AI: dialogue, AI: tool_calls: JSON name/arguments records, and<br>AI: tool_call_results: JSON results. System messages are excluded. These<br>fixed labels apply even when custom artifact transcript labels are configured.<br>Tool payloads participate in first-match and all-match extraction in event order.<br>An empty message array falls back to the supplied transcript verbatim.<br>Production-call extraction and call preview use their existing transcripts,<br>so previewing the same output on a simulation's call can return a different result.<br><br>Only used when type is 'regex'. Supports both raw patterns (e.g. '\d+') and<br>regex literal format (e.g. '/\d+/gi'). Uses RE2 syntax for safety.<br><br>The result depends on the schema type:<br>- boolean: true if the pattern matches, false otherwise<br>- string: the first match or first capture group<br>- number/integer: the first match parsed as a number<br>- array: all matches|
|» » model|body|[WorkflowOpenAIModel](#schemaworkflowopenaimodel) \| [WorkflowAnthropicModel](#schemaworkflowanthropicmodel) \| [WorkflowAnthropicBedrockModel](#schemaworkflowanthropicbedrockmodel) \| [WorkflowGoogleModel](#schemaworkflowgooglemodel) \| [WorkflowCustomModel](#schemaworkflowcustommodel)|false|This is the model that will be used to extract the structured output.<br><br>To provide your own custom system and user prompts for structured output extraction, populate the messages array with your system and user messages. You can specify liquid templating in your system and user messages.<br>For text extraction, you must reference 'transcript', 'messages', or 'messagesWithConfidence' with the `{{}}` syntax to access the conversation history.<br>In structured outputs, `{{messages}}` includes conversation text and tool calls/results but omits caller transcription-confidence fields. Text extraction can use `{{messagesWithConfidence}}` when the output needs the original message history with transcription confidence. These variables also apply in structured-output schema descriptions. Audio-targeted (`messages-with-audio`) extraction ignores custom messages. Stored call artifacts and API messages retain their confidence data.<br>Between the system or user messages, you must reference a variation of the structured output with the `{{}}` syntax to access the structured output definition.<br>i.e.:<br>`{{structuredOutput}}`<br>`{{structuredOutput.name}}`<br>`{{structuredOutput.description}}`<br>`{{structuredOutput.schema}}`<br><br>If model is not specified, GPT-4.1 will be used by default for extraction, utilizing default system and user prompts.<br>If messages or required fields are not specified, the default system and user prompts will be used.|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowOpenAIModel](#schemaworkflowopenaimodel)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowAnthropicModel](#schemaworkflowanthropicmodel)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowAnthropicBedrockModel](#schemaworkflowanthropicbedrockmodel)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowGoogleModel](#schemaworkflowgooglemodel)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowCustomModel](#schemaworkflowcustommodel)|false|none|
|» » compliancePlan|body|object|false|Compliance configuration for this output. Only enable overrides if no sensitive data will be stored.|
|» » » forceStoreOnHipaaEnabled|body|boolean|false|Force storage for this output under HIPAA. Only enable if output contains no sensitive data.|
|» » conditions|body|[[MinMessagesCondition](#schemaminmessagescondition) \| [MinCallDurationCondition](#schemamincalldurationcondition) \| [EndedReasonCondition](#schemaendedreasoncondition)]|false|These are the conditions that gate the execution of this structured output. Every condition must pass for the structured output to run (AND semantics). When omitted or empty, no user-defined conditions gate this output. Send null to clear a previously saved gate.|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[MinMessagesCondition](#schemaminmessagescondition)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[MinCallDurationCondition](#schemamincalldurationcondition)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[EndedReasonCondition](#schemaendedreasoncondition)|false|none|
|» » name|body|string|true|This is the name of the structured output.|
|» » schema|body|object|true|This is the JSON Schema definition for the structured output.<br><br>This is required when creating a structured output. Defines the structure and validation rules for the data that will be extracted. Supports all JSON Schema features including:<br>- Objects and nested properties<br>- Arrays and array validation<br>- String, number, boolean, and null types<br>- Enums and const values<br>- Validation constraints (min/max, patterns, etc.)<br>- Composition with allOf, anyOf, oneOf|
|» » » type|body|string|true|This is the type of output you'd like.<br><br>`string`, `number`, `integer`, `boolean` are the primitive types and should be obvious.<br><br>`array` and `object` are more interesting and quite powerful. They allow you to define nested structures.<br><br>For `array`, you can define the schema of the items in the array using the `items` property.<br><br>For `object`, you can define the properties of the object using the `properties` property.|
|» » » items|body|object|false|This is required if the type is "array". This is the schema of the items in the array. This is a recursive reference to JsonSchema.|
|» » » properties|body|object|false|This is required if the type is "object". This specifies the properties of the object. This is a map of property names to JsonSchema objects.|
|» » » » **additionalProperties**|body|[JsonSchema](#schemajsonschema)|false|none|
|» » » description|body|string|false|This is the description to help the model understand what it needs to output.|
|» » » pattern|body|string|false|This is the pattern of the string. This is a regex that will be used to validate the data in question. To use a common format, use the `format` property instead.<br><br>OpenAI documentation: https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs#supported-properties|
|» » » format|body|string|false|This is the format of the string. To pass a regex, use the `pattern` property instead.<br><br>OpenAI documentation: https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs?api-mode=chat&type-restrictions=string-restrictions|
|» » » required|body|[string]|false|This is a list of properties that are required.<br><br>This only makes sense if the type is "object".|
|» » » enum|body|[string]|false|This array specifies the allowed values that can be used to restrict the output of the model.|
|» » » title|body|string|false|This is the title of the schema.|
|» » description|body|string|false|This is the description of what the structured output extracts.<br><br>Use this to provide context about what data will be extracted and how it will be used.|
|» » assistantIds|body|[string]|false|These are the assistant IDs that this structured output is linked to.<br><br>When linked to assistants, this structured output will be available for extraction during those assistant's calls.|
|» » workflowIds|body|[string]|false|These are the workflow IDs that this structured output is linked to.<br><br>When linked to workflows, this structured output will be available for extraction during those workflow's execution.|
|» callIds|body|[string]|true|This is the array of callIds that will be updated with the new structured output value. If preview is true, this array must be provided and contain exactly 1 callId.<br>If preview is false, up to 100 callIds may be provided.|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|sortOrder|query|string|false|This is the sort order for pagination. Defaults to 'DESC'.|
|sortBy|query|string|false|This is the column to sort by. Defaults to 'createdAt'.|
|limit|query|number|false|This is the maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.|
|createdAtGt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than the specified value.|
|createdAtLt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is less than the specified value.|
|createdAtGe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|createdAtLe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtGt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than the specified value.|
|updatedAtLt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than the specified value.|
|updatedAtGe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtLe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|

|» » backgroundSpeechDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|This enables filtering of noise and background speech while the user is talking.<br><br>Features:<br>- Smart denoising using Krisp<br>- Fourier denoising<br><br>Smart denoising can be combined with or used independently of Fourier denoising.<br><br>Order of precedence:<br>- Smart denoising<br>- Fourier denoising|
|» » » smartDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » fourierDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.<br><br>This can be combined with smart denoising, and will be run afterwards.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.|
|» » » » mediaDetectionEnabled|body|boolean|false|Whether automatic media detection is enabled. When enabled, the filter will automatically<br>detect consistent background TV/music/radio and switch to more aggressive filtering settings.<br>Only applies when enabled is true.|
|» » » » staticThreshold|body|number|false|Static threshold in dB used as fallback when no baseline is established.|
|» » » » baselineOffsetDb|body|number|false|How far below the rolling baseline to filter audio, in dB.<br>Lower values (e.g., -10) are more aggressive, higher values (e.g., -20) are more conservative.|
|» » » » windowSizeMs|body|number|false|Rolling window size in milliseconds for calculating the audio baseline.<br>Larger windows adapt more slowly but are more stable.|
|» » » » baselinePercentile|body|number|false|Percentile to use for baseline calculation (1-99).<br>Higher percentiles (e.g., 85) focus on louder speech, lower percentiles (e.g., 50) include quieter speech.|
|» » analysisPlan|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** This is the plan for analysis of assistant's calls. Stored in `call.analysis`.|
|» » » minMessagesThreshold|body|number|false|**Deprecated.** The minimum number of messages required to run the analysis plan.<br>If the number of messages is less than this, analysis will be skipped.<br><br>@default 2|
|» » » summaryPlan|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** This is the plan for generating the summary of the call. This outputs to `call.analysis.summary`.|
|» » » » messages|body|[object]|false|These are the messages used to generate the summary.<br><br>@default: ```<br>[<br>  {<br>    "role": "system",<br>    "content": "You are an expert note-taker. You will be given a transcript of a call. Summarize the call in 2-3 sentences. DO NOT return anything except the summary."<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here is the transcript:\n\n{{transcript}}\n\n. Here is the ended reason of the call:\n\n{{endedReason}}\n\n"<br>  }<br>]```<br><br>You can customize by providing any messages you want.<br><br>Here are the template variables available:<br>- {{transcript}}: The transcript of the call from `call.artifact.transcript` <br>- {{systemPrompt}}: The system prompt of the call from `assistant.model.messages[type=system].content` <br>- {{messages}}: The messages of the call from `assistant.model.messages` <br>- {{endedReason}}: The ended reason of the call from `call.endedReason`|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether a summary is generated and stored in `call.analysis.summary`. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to disable the summary, set this to false.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » » timeoutSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long the request is tried before giving up. When request times out, `call.analysis.summary` will be empty.<br><br>Usage:<br>- To guarantee the summary is generated, set this value high. Note, this will delay the end of call report in cases where model is slow to respond.<br><br>@default 5 seconds|

Here is the ended reason of the call:\n\n{{endedReason}}\n\n"<br>  }<br>]```<br><br>You can customize by providing any messages you want.<br><br>Here are the template variables available:<br>- {{transcript}}: the transcript of the call from `call.artifact.transcript`- {{systemPrompt}}: the system prompt of the call from `assistant.model.messages[type=system].content`- {{messages}}: the messages of the call from `assistant.model.messages`- {{schema}}: the schema of the structured data from `structuredDataPlan.schema`- {{endedReason}}: the ended reason of the call from `call.endedReason`|

|» » » » schema|body|object|false|This is the schema of the structured data. The output is stored in `call.analysis.structuredData`.<br><br>Complete guide on JSON Schema can be found [here](https://ajv.js.org/json-schema.html#json-data-type).|
|» » » » timeoutSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long the request is tried before giving up. |» » » successEvaluationPlan|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** This is the plan for generating the success evaluation of the call. This outputs to `call.analysis.successEvaluation`.|
|» » » » rubric|body|string|false|This enforces the rubric of the evaluation. The output is stored in `call.analysis.successEvaluation`.<br><br>Options include:<br>- 'NumericScale': A scale of 1 to 10.<br>- 'DescriptiveScale': A scale of Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor.<br>- 'Checklist': A checklist of criteria and their status.<br>- 'Matrix': A grid that evaluates multiple criteria across different performance levels.<br>- 'PercentageScale': A scale of 0% to 100%.<br>- 'LikertScale': A scale of Strongly Agree, Agree, Neutral, Disagree, Strongly Disagree.<br>- 'AutomaticRubric': Automatically break down evaluation into several criteria, each with its own score.<br>- 'PassFail': A simple 'true' if call passed, 'false' if not.<br><br>Default is 'PassFail'.|
|» » » » messages|body|[object]|false|These are the messages used to generate the success evaluation.<br><br>@default: ```<br>[<br>  {<br>    "role": "system",<br>    "content": "You are an expert call evaluator. DO NOT return anything except the result.\n\nRubric:\\n{{rubric}}\n\nOnly respond with the result."<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here is the transcript:\n\n{{transcript}}\n\n"<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here was the system prompt of the call:\n\n{{systemPrompt}}\n\n. Here is the ended reason of the call:\n\n{{endedReason}}\n\n"<br>  }<br>]```<br><br>You can customize by providing any messages you want.<br><br>Here are the template variables available:<br>- {{transcript}}: the transcript of the call from `call.artifact.transcript`- {{systemPrompt}}: the system prompt of the call from `assistant.model.messages[type=system].content`- {{messages}}: the messages of the call from `assistant.model.messages`- {{rubric}}: the rubric of the success evaluation from `successEvaluationPlan.rubric`- {{endedReason}}: the ended reason of the call from `call.endedReason`|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether a success evaluation is generated and stored in `call.analysis.successEvaluation`. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to disable the success evaluation, set this to false.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » » timeoutSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long the request is tried before giving up. |» » » recordingEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether assistant's calls are recorded. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you don't want to record the calls, set this to false.<br>- If you want to record the calls when `assistant.hipaaEnabled` (deprecated) or `assistant.compliancePlan.hipaaEnabled` explicity set this to true and make sure to provide S3 or GCP credentials on the Provider Credentials page in the Dashboard.<br><br>You can find the recording at `call.artifact.recordingUrl` and `call.artifact.stereoRecordingUrl` after the call is ended.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » recordingFormat|body|string|false|This determines the format of the recording. Defaults to `wav;l16`.<br><br>@default 'wav;l16'|
|» » » recordingUseCustomStorageEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether to use custom storage (S3 or GCP) for call recordings when storage credentials are configured.<br><br>When set to false, recordings will be stored on Vapi's storage instead of your custom storage, even if you have custom storage credentials configured.<br><br>Usage:<br>- Set to false if you have custom storage configured but want to store recordings on Vapi's storage for this assistant.<br>- Set to true (or leave unset) to use your custom storage for recordings when available.<br><br>If your organization has ZDR (zero data retention) or PCI enabled, recordings are never written to Vapi storage. In that case, false means "do not use my custom storage", so nothing is stored at all.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » videoRecordingEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the video is recorded during the call. Defaults to false. Only relevant for `webCall` type.<br><br>You can find the video recording at `call.artifact.videoRecordingUrl` after the call is ended.<br><br>@default false|
|» » » fullMessageHistoryEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the artifact contains the full message history, even after handoff context engineering. Defaults to false.|
|» » » pcapEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the SIP packet capture is enabled. Defaults to true. Only relevant for `phone` type calls where phone number's provider is `vapi` or `byo-phone-number`.<br><br>You can find the packet capture at `call.artifact.pcapUrl` after the call is ended.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » pcapS3PathPrefix|body|string|false|This is the path where the SIP packet capture will be uploaded. This is only used if you have provided S3 or GCP credentials on the Provider Credentials page in the Dashboard.<br><br>If credential.s3PathPrefix or credential.bucketPlan.path is set, this will append to it.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to upload the packet capture to a specific path, set this to the path. Example: `/my-assistant-captures`.<br>- If you want to upload the packet capture to the root of the bucket, set this to `/`.<br><br>@default '/'|
|» » » pcapUseCustomStorageEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether to use custom storage (S3 or GCP) for SIP packet captures when storage credentials are configured.<br><br>When set to false, packet captures will be stored on Vapi's storage instead of your custom storage, even if you have custom storage credentials configured.<br><br>Usage:<br>- Set to false if you have custom storage configured but want to store packet captures on Vapi's storage for this assistant.<br>- Set to true (or leave unset) to use your custom storage for packet captures when available.<br><br>If your organization has ZDR (zero data retention) or PCI enabled, packet captures are never written to Vapi storage. In that case, false means "do not use my custom storage", so nothing is stored at all.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » loggingEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the call logs are enabled. Defaults to true.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » loggingUseCustomStorageEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether to use custom storage (S3 or GCP) for call logs when storage credentials are configured.<br><br>When set to false, logs will be stored on Vapi's storage instead of your custom storage, even if you have custom storage credentials configured.<br><br>Usage:<br>- Set to false if you have custom storage configured but want to store logs on Vapi's storage for this assistant.<br>- Set to true (or leave unset) to use your custom storage for logs when available.<br><br>If your organization has ZDR (zero data retention) or PCI enabled, logs are never written to Vapi storage. In that case, false means "do not use my custom storage", so nothing is stored at all.<br><br>@default true|

|» » backgroundSpeechDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|This enables filtering of noise and background speech while the user is talking.<br><br>Features:<br>- Smart denoising using Krisp<br>- Fourier denoising<br><br>Smart denoising can be combined with or used independently of Fourier denoising.<br><br>Order of precedence:<br>- Smart denoising<br>- Fourier denoising|
|» » » smartDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » fourierDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.<br><br>This can be combined with smart denoising, and will be run afterwards.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.|
|» » » » mediaDetectionEnabled|body|boolean|false|Whether automatic media detection is enabled. When enabled, the filter will automatically<br>detect consistent background TV/music/radio and switch to more aggressive filtering settings.<br>Only applies when enabled is true.|
|» » » » staticThreshold|body|number|false|Static threshold in dB used as fallback when no baseline is established.|
|» » » » baselineOffsetDb|body|number|false|How far below the rolling baseline to filter audio, in dB.<br>Lower values (e.g., -10) are more aggressive, higher values (e.g., -20) are more conservative.|
|» » » » windowSizeMs|body|number|false|Rolling window size in milliseconds for calculating the audio baseline.<br>Larger windows adapt more slowly but are more stable.|
|» » » » baselinePercentile|body|number|false|Percentile to use for baseline calculation (1-99).<br>Higher percentiles (e.g., 85) focus on louder speech, lower percentiles (e.g., 50) include quieter speech.|

|» » » minMessagesThreshold|body|number|false|**Deprecated.** The minimum number of messages required to run the analysis plan.<br>If the number of messages is less than this, analysis will be skipped.<br><br>@default 2|

|» » » » messages|body|[object]|false|These are the messages used to generate the summary.<br><br>@default: ```<br>[<br>  {<br>    "role": "system",<br>    "content": "You are an expert note-taker. DO NOT return anything except the summary."<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here is the transcript:\n\n{{transcript}}\n\n. Here is the ended reason of the call:\n\n{{endedReason}}\n\n"<br>  }<br>]```<br><br>You can customize by providing any messages you want.<br><br>Here are the template variables available:<br>- {{transcript}}: The transcript of the call from `call.artifact.transcript` <br>- {{systemPrompt}}: The system prompt of the call from `assistant.model.messages[type=system].content` <br>- {{messages}}: The messages of the call from `assistant.model.messages` <br>- {{endedReason}}: The ended reason of the call from `call.endedReason`|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether a summary is generated and stored in `call.analysis.summary`. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to disable the summary, set this to false.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » » timeoutSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long the request is tried before giving up. Note, this will delay the end of call report in cases where model is slow to respond.<br><br>@default 5 seconds|

|» » » » timeoutSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long the request is tried before giving up. |» » » » rubric|body|string|false|This enforces the rubric of the evaluation. The output is stored in `call.analysis.successEvaluation`.<br><br>Options include:<br>- 'NumericScale': A scale of 1 to 10.<br>- 'DescriptiveScale': A scale of Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor.<br>- 'Checklist': A checklist of criteria and their status.<br>- 'Matrix': A grid that evaluates multiple criteria across different performance levels.<br>- 'PercentageScale': A scale of 0% to 100%.<br>- 'LikertScale': A scale of Strongly Agree, Agree, Neutral, Disagree, Strongly Disagree.<br>- 'AutomaticRubric': Automatically break down evaluation into several criteria, each with its own score.<br>- 'PassFail': A simple 'true' if call passed, 'false' if not.<br><br>Default is 'PassFail'.|
|» » » » messages|body|[object]|false|These are the messages used to generate the success evaluation.<br><br>@default: ```<br>[<br>  {<br>    "role": "system",<br>    "content": "You are an expert call evaluator. DO NOT return anything except the result.\n\nRubric:\\n{{rubric}}\n\nOnly respond with the result."<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here is the transcript:\n\n{{transcript}}\n\n"<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here was the system prompt of the call:\n\n{{systemPrompt}}\n\n. Here is the ended reason of the call:\n\n{{endedReason}}\n\n"<br>  }<br>]```<br><br>You can customize by providing any messages you want.<br><br>Here are the template variables available:<br>- {{transcript}}: the transcript of the call from `call.artifact.transcript`- {{systemPrompt}}: the system prompt of the call from `assistant.model.messages[type=system].content`- {{messages}}: the messages of the call from `assistant.model.messages`- {{rubric}}: the rubric of the success evaluation from `successEvaluationPlan.rubric`- {{endedReason}}: the ended reason of the call from `call.endedReason`|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether a success evaluation is generated and stored in `call.analysis.successEvaluation`. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to disable the success evaluation, set this to false.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » » timeoutSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long the request is tried before giving up. |» » » recordingEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether assistant's calls are recorded. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you don't want to record the calls, set this to false.<br>- If you want to record the calls when `assistant.hipaaEnabled` (deprecated) or `assistant.compliancePlan.hipaaEnabled` explicity set this to true and make sure to provide S3 or GCP credentials on the Provider Credentials page in the Dashboard.<br><br>You can find the recording at `call.artifact.recordingUrl` and `call.artifact.stereoRecordingUrl` after the call is ended.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » recordingFormat|body|string|false|This determines the format of the recording. Defaults to `wav;l16`.<br><br>@default 'wav;l16'|
|» » » recordingUseCustomStorageEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether to use custom storage (S3 or GCP) for call recordings when storage credentials are configured.<br><br>When set to false, recordings will be stored on Vapi's storage instead of your custom storage, even if you have custom storage credentials configured.<br><br>Usage:<br>- Set to false if you have custom storage configured but want to store recordings on Vapi's storage for this assistant.<br>- Set to true (or leave unset) to use your custom storage for recordings when available.<br><br>If your organization has ZDR (zero data retention) or PCI enabled, recordings are never written to Vapi storage. In that case, false means "do not use my custom storage", so nothing is stored at all.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » videoRecordingEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the video is recorded during the call. Defaults to false. Only relevant for `webCall` type.<br><br>You can find the video recording at `call.artifact.videoRecordingUrl` after the call is ended.<br><br>@default false|
|» » » fullMessageHistoryEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the artifact contains the full message history, even after handoff context engineering. Defaults to false.|
|» » » pcapEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the SIP packet capture is enabled. Defaults to true. |» » » pcapS3PathPrefix|body|string|false|This is the path where the SIP packet capture will be uploaded. Example: `/my-assistant-captures`.<br>- If you want to upload the packet capture to the root of the bucket, set this to `/`.<br><br>@default '/'|
|» » » pcapUseCustomStorageEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether to use custom storage (S3 or GCP) for SIP packet captures when storage credentials are configured.<br><br>When set to false, packet captures will be stored on Vapi's storage instead of your custom storage, even if you have custom storage credentials configured.<br><br>Usage:<br>- Set to false if you have custom storage configured but want to store packet captures on Vapi's storage for this assistant.<br>- Set to true (or leave unset) to use your custom storage for packet captures when available.<br><br>If your organization has ZDR (zero data retention) or PCI enabled, packet captures are never written to Vapi storage. In that case, false means "do not use my custom storage", so nothing is stored at all.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » loggingEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether the call logs are enabled. Defaults to true.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » loggingUseCustomStorageEnabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether to use custom storage (S3 or GCP) for call logs when storage credentials are configured.<br><br>When set to false, logs will be stored on Vapi's storage instead of your custom storage, even if you have custom storage credentials configured.<br><br>Usage:<br>- Set to false if you have custom storage configured but want to store logs on Vapi's storage for this assistant.<br>- Set to true (or leave unset) to use your custom storage for logs when available.<br><br>If your organization has ZDR (zero data retention) or PCI enabled, logs are never written to Vapi storage. In that case, false means "do not use my custom storage", so nothing is stored at all.<br><br>@default true|

<h1 id="vapi-api-simulation-scenarios">Simulation Scenarios</h1>

## List Scenarios

<a id="opIdScenarioController_findAll"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/eval/simulation/scenario \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /eval/simulation/scenario`

<h3 id="list-scenarios-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|idAny|query|[string]|false|Return only scenarios matching the provided ids|
|name|query|string|false|Search by scenario name|
|page|query|number|false|This is the page number to return. Defaults to 1.|
|sortOrder|query|string|false|This is the sort order for pagination. Defaults to 'DESC'.|
|sortBy|query|string|false|This is the column to sort by. Defaults to 'createdAt'.|
|limit|query|number|false|This is the maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.|
|createdAtGt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than the specified value.|
|createdAtLt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is less than the specified value.|
|createdAtGe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|createdAtLe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtGt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than the specified value.|
|updatedAtLt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than the specified value.|
|updatedAtGe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtLe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sortOrder|ASC|
|sortOrder|DESC|
|sortBy|createdAt|
|sortBy|duration|
|sortBy|cost|

|» » variableValues|body|object|false|These are values that will be used to replace the template variables in the assistant messages and other text-based fields.<br>This uses LiquidJS syntax. https://liquidjs.com/tutorials/intro-to-liquid.html<br><br>So for example, `{{ name }}` will be replaced with the value of `name` in `variableValues`.<br>`{{"now" \| date: "%b %d, %Y, %I:%M %p", "America/New_York"}}` will be replaced with the current date and time in New York.<br> Some VAPI reserved defaults:<br> - *customer* - the customer object|
|» » name|body|string|false|This is the name of the assistant.<br><br>This is required when you want to transfer between assistants in a call.|
|» » voicemailMessage|body|string|false|This is the message that the assistant will say if the call is forwarded to voicemail.<br><br>If unspecified, it will hang up.|
|» » endCallMessage|body|string|false|This is the message that the assistant will say if it ends the call.<br><br>If unspecified, it will hang up without saying anything.|
|» » endCallPhrases|body|[string]|false|This list contains phrases that, if spoken by the assistant, will trigger the call to be hung up. Case insensitive.|
|» » compliancePlan|body|[CompliancePlan](#schemacomplianceplan)|false|none|
|» » metadata|body|object|false|This is for metadata you want to store on the assistant.|
|» » backgroundSpeechDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|This enables filtering of noise and background speech while the user is talking.<br><br>Features:<br>- Smart denoising using Krisp<br>- Fourier denoising<br><br>Smart denoising can be combined with or used independently of Fourier denoising.<br><br>Order of precedence:<br>- Smart denoising<br>- Fourier denoising|
|» » » smartDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » fourierDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.<br><br>This can be combined with smart denoising, and will be run afterwards.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.|
|» » » » mediaDetectionEnabled|body|boolean|false|Whether automatic media detection is enabled. When enabled, the filter will automatically<br>detect consistent background TV/music/radio and switch to more aggressive filtering settings.<br>Only applies when enabled is true.|
|» » » » staticThreshold|body|number|false|Static threshold in dB used as fallback when no baseline is established.|
|» » » » baselineOffsetDb|body|number|false|How far below the rolling baseline to filter audio, in dB.<br>Lower values (e.g., -10) are more aggressive, higher values (e.g., -20) are more conservative.|
|» » » » windowSizeMs|body|number|false|Rolling window size in milliseconds for calculating the audio baseline.<br>Larger windows adapt more slowly but are more stable.|
|» » » » baselinePercentile|body|number|false|Percentile to use for baseline calculation (1-99).<br>Higher percentiles (e.g., 85) focus on louder speech, lower percentiles (e.g., 50) include quieter speech.|
|» » analysisPlan|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** This is the plan for analysis of assistant's calls. Stored in `call.analysis`.|
|» » » minMessagesThreshold|body|number|false|**Deprecated.** The minimum number of messages required to run the analysis plan.<br>If the number of messages is less than this, analysis will be skipped.<br><br>@default 2|
|» » » summaryPlan|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** This is the plan for generating the summary of the call. This outputs to `call.analysis.summary`.|
|» » » » messages|body|[object]|false|These are the messages used to generate the summary.<br><br>@default: ```<br>[<br>  {<br>    "role": "system",<br>    "content": "You are an expert note-taker. You will be given a transcript of a call. Summarize the call in 2-3 sentences. DO NOT return anything except the summary."<br>  },<br>  {<br>    "role": "user",<br>    "content": "Here is the transcript:\n\n{{transcript}}\n\n. Here is the ended reason of the call:\n\n{{endedReason}}\n\n"<br>  }<br>]```<br><br>You can customize by providing any messages you want.<br><br>Here are the template variables available:<br>- {{transcript}}: The transcript of the call from `call.artifact.transcript` <br>- {{systemPrompt}}: The system prompt of the call from `assistant.model.messages[type=system].content` <br>- {{messages}}: The messages of the call from `assistant.model.messages` <br>- {{endedReason}}: The ended reason of the call from `call.endedReason`|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|This determines whether a summary is generated and stored in `call.analysis.summary`. Defaults to true.<br><br>Usage:<br>- If you want to disable the summary, set this to false.<br><br>@default true|
|» » » » timeoutSeconds|body|number|false|This is how long the request is tried before giving up. When request times out, `call.analysis.summary` will be empty.<br><br>Usage:<br>- To guarantee the summary is generated, set this value high. |» » variableValues|body|object|false|These are values that will be used to replace the template variables in the assistant messages and other text-based fields.<br>This uses LiquidJS syntax. https://liquidjs.com/tutorials/intro-to-liquid.html<br><br>So for example, `{{ name }}` will be replaced with the value of `name` in `variableValues`.<br>`{{"now" \| date: "%b %d, %Y, %I:%M %p", "America/New_York"}}` will be replaced with the current date and time in New York.<br> Some VAPI reserved defaults:<br> - *customer* - the customer object|
|» » name|body|string|false|This is the name of the assistant.<br><br>This is required when you want to transfer between assistants in a call.|
|» » voicemailMessage|body|string|false|This is the message that the assistant will say if the call is forwarded to voicemail.<br><br>If unspecified, it will hang up.|
|» » endCallMessage|body|string|false|This is the message that the assistant will say if it ends the call.<br><br>If unspecified, it will hang up without saying anything.|
|» » endCallPhrases|body|[string]|false|This list contains phrases that, if spoken by the assistant, will trigger the call to be hung up. Case insensitive.|
|» » compliancePlan|body|[CompliancePlan](#schemacomplianceplan)|false|none|
|» » metadata|body|object|false|This is for metadata you want to store on the assistant.|
|» » backgroundSpeechDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|This enables filtering of noise and background speech while the user is talking.<br><br>Features:<br>- Smart denoising using Krisp<br>- Fourier denoising<br><br>Smart denoising can be combined with or used independently of Fourier denoising.<br><br>Order of precedence:<br>- Smart denoising<br>- Fourier denoising|
|» » » smartDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether smart denoising using Krisp is enabled.|
|» » » fourierDenoisingPlan|body|object|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.<br><br>This can be combined with smart denoising, and will be run afterwards.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether Fourier denoising is enabled. Note that this is experimental and may not work as expected.|
|» » » » mediaDetectionEnabled|body|boolean|false|Whether automatic media detection is enabled. When enabled, the filter will automatically<br>detect consistent background TV/music/radio and switch to more aggressive filtering settings.<br>Only applies when enabled is true.|
|» » » » staticThreshold|body|number|false|Static threshold in dB used as fallback when no baseline is established.|
|» » » » baselineOffsetDb|body|number|false|How far below the rolling baseline to filter audio, in dB.<br>Lower values (e.g., -10) are more aggressive, higher values (e.g., -20) are more conservative.|

<h1 id="vapi-api-simulation-runs">Simulation Runs</h1>

## List Simulation Runs

<a id="opIdSimulationRunController_findAll"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/eval/simulation/run \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /eval/simulation/run`

<h3 id="list-simulation-runs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|suiteId|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Filter by simulation suite ids|
|status|query|string|false|Filter by status|
|filterStatus|query|string|false|Filter by aggregate run result status|
|targetType|query|string|false|Filter by target type|
|targetId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by target id|
|page|query|number|false|This is the page number to return. Defaults to 1.|
|sortOrder|query|string|false|This is the sort order for pagination. Defaults to 'DESC'.|
|sortBy|query|string|false|This is the column to sort by. Defaults to 'createdAt'.|
|limit|query|number|false|This is the maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.|
|createdAtGt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than the specified value.|
|createdAtLt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is less than the specified value.|
|createdAtGe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|createdAtLe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the createdAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtGt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than the specified value.|
|updatedAtLt|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than the specified value.|
|updatedAtGe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtLe|query|string(date-time)|false|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|queued|
|status|running|
|status|ended|
|filterStatus|passed|
|filterStatus|failed|
|filterStatus|running|
|targetType|assistant|
|targetType|squad|
|sortOrder|ASC|
|sortOrder|DESC|
|sortBy|createdAt|
|sortBy|duration|
|sortBy|cost|


<h3 id="create-simulation-run-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|Makes the request safe to retry. A retry with the same key and the same body returns the run the first request created, with `reused: true`, instead of starting another. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409. Up to 255 printable ASCII characters, scoped to your organization; a key stays bound to its run while the run exists.|
|user-agent|header|string|false|Identifies the client starting the simulation run|
|body|body|[CreateSimulationRunDTO](#schemacreatesimulationrundto)|true|none|
|» includeTargetStructuredOutputs|body|boolean|false|Generate directly attached target structured outputs. Default false. Enabled extraction may incur additional model charges.|
|» simulations|body|[[SimulationRunSimulationEntry](#schemasimulationrunsimulationentry) \| [SimulationRunSuiteEntry](#schemasimulationrunsuiteentry)]|true|Array of simulations and/or suites to run|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SimulationRunSimulationEntry](#schemasimulationrunsimulationentry)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SimulationRunSuiteEntry](#schemasimulationrunsuiteentry)|false|none|
|» target|body|[SimulationRunTargetAssistant](#schemasimulationruntargetassistant) \| [SimulationRunTargetSquad](#schemasimulationruntargetsquad)|true|Target to test against|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SimulationRunTargetAssistant](#schemasimulationruntargetassistant)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SimulationRunTargetSquad](#schemasimulationruntargetsquad)|false|none|
|» iterations|body|number|false|Number of times to run each simulation (default: 1)|
|» transport|body|object|false|Transport configuration for the simulation runs|
|» » provider|body|string|true|Transport provider for the simulation run|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » provider|vapi.websocket|
|» » provider|vapi.webchat|

<h3 id="create-simulation-run-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created||[CreateSimulationRunResponse](#schemacreatesimulationrunresponse)|
|402|Payment Required|The organization is not eligible to start this run.|[SimulationRunPaymentRequiredResponse](#schemasimulationrunpaymentrequiredresponse)|
|409|Conflict|The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body, or a concurrent request with the same key did not complete.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer
</aside>

```bash
curl https://api.vapi.ai/eval/simulation/run/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /eval/simulation/run/{id}`

|id|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier for the resource.|
