<a id="tocsusermessage"></a>

```json
{
  "role": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "time": 0,
  "endTime": 0,
  "secondsFromStart": 0,
  "duration": 0,
  "isFiltered": true,
  "detectedThreats": [
    "string"
  ],
  "originalMessage": "string",
  "confidence": 0,
  "confidenceSource": "provider",
  "metadata": {
    "wordLevelConfidence": [
      {
        "word": "string",
        "start": 0,
        "end": 0,
        "confidence": 0,
        "punctuated_word": "string",
        "language": "string",
        "speaker": 0
      }
    ],
    "type": "string",
    "source": "string"
  },
  "speakerLabel": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|role|string|true|none|The role of the user in the conversation.|
|message|string|true|none|The message content from the user.|
|time|number|true|none|The timestamp when the message was sent.|
|endTime|number|true|none|The timestamp when the message ended.|
|secondsFromStart|number|true|none|The number of seconds from the start of the conversation.|
|duration|number|false|none|The duration of the message in seconds.|
|isFiltered|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the message was filtered for security reasons.|
|detectedThreats|[string]|false|none|List of detected security threats if the message was filtered.|
|originalMessage|string|false|none|The original message before filtering (only included if content was filtered).|
|confidence|number|false|none|The transcriber's confidence score for this message, in [0, 1]. Only<br>ever set alongside `confidenceSource` — see there for why an unmarked<br>or out-of-range score is never stored.|
|confidenceSource|string|false|none|Whether `confidence` came directly from the transcriber ('provider') or<br>was computed by Vapi ('derived').<br><br>'derived' means Vapi computed the score from the transcriber's per-word<br>scores; the exact aggregation is provider-specific (an average, a median<br>or a minimum, depending on the transcriber). It is also 'derived' when<br>consecutive transcript fragments were merged into one message, where the<br>score is the minimum across the fragments.<br><br>Absent means no trustworthy score was available for this message: either<br>the transcriber does not report one, or the value it reported was invalid<br>and was dropped. A merged message is unmarked whenever any fragment it<br>contains was unmarked.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The metadata associated with the message. Currently used to store the transcriber's word level confidence.|
|speakerLabel|string|false|none|Stable speaker label for diarized user speakers (e.g., "Speaker 1").|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|confidenceSource|provider|
|confidenceSource|derived|

<h2 id="tocS_ModelCost">ModelCost</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemamodelcost"></a>
<a id="schema_ModelCost"></a>
<a id="tocSmodelcost"></a>
<a id="tocsmodelcost"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "model",
  "seconds": 0,
  "usageComplete": true,
  "model": {},
  "promptTokens": 0,
  "completionTokens": 0,
  "cachedPromptTokens": 0,
  "reasoningTokens": 0,
  "serviceTierBreakdown": [
    {
      "serviceTier": "string",
      "cost": 0,
      "promptTokens": 0,
      "completionTokens": 0,
      "cachedPromptTokens": 0,
      "reasoningTokens": 0
    }
  ],
  "cost": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of cost, always 'model' for this class.|
|seconds|number|false|none|Provider-reported billable duration in seconds. Currently supplied for GPT-Live; omitted for token-billed models.|
|usageComplete|boolean|false|none|Whether the reported usage is complete. False means the cost reflects missing or partial usage and may understate provider spend. Omitted when the provider integration does not report completeness.|
|model|object|true|none|This is the model that was used during the call.<br><br>This matches one of the following:<br>- `call.assistant.model`,<br>- `call.assistantId->model`,<br>- `call.squad[n].assistant.model`,<br>- `call.squad[n].assistantId->model`,<br>- `call.squadId->[n].assistant.model`,<br>- `call.squadId->[n].assistantId->model`.|
|promptTokens|number|true|none|This is the number of prompt tokens used in the call. These should be total prompt tokens used in the call for single assistant calls, while squad calls will have multiple model costs one for each assistant that was used.|
|completionTokens|number|true|none|This is the number of completion tokens generated in the call. These should be total completion tokens used in the call for single assistant calls, while squad calls will have multiple model costs one for each assistant that was used.|
|cachedPromptTokens|number|false|none|This is the number of cached prompt tokens used in the call. This is only applicable to certain providers (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI) that support prompt caching. Cached tokens are billed at a discounted rate.|
|reasoningTokens|number|false|none|This is the number of reasoning tokens generated in the call. This is only applicable to reasoning models (e.g., OpenAI o-series, GPT-5) on providers that report them.<br><br>This is a **subset of `completionTokens`**, not an addition to it: reasoning tokens are already counted in `completionTokens` and are already billed at the output-token rate. It is reported separately for visibility only and does not affect `cost`.|
|serviceTierBreakdown|[[ModelCostServiceTierBreakdown](#schemamodelcostservicetierbreakdown)]|false|none|This is the cost split by OpenAI service tier. It is only set on call costs, and only when OpenAI reported the tier it served for a request that asked for Fast mode.<br><br>There is one row per reported tier, plus one row without `serviceTier` for usage with no reported tier. The rows add up to the token counts above, and to `cost` within rounding.|
|cost|number|true|none|This is the cost of the component in USD.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|model|

```json
{
  "type": "analysis",

  "completionTokens": 0,
  "cachedPromptTokens": 0,
  "reasoningTokens": 0,

    {
      "structuredOutputId": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "cost": 0,
      "promptTokens": 0,
      "completionTokens": 0,
      "cachedPromptTokens": 0,
      "reasoningTokens": 0
    }
  ],
  "cost": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of cost, always 'analysis' for this class.|
|analysisType|string|true|none|This is the type of analysis performed.|
|model|object|true|none|This is the model that was used to perform the analysis.|
|promptTokens|number|true|none|This is the number of prompt tokens used in the analysis.|
|completionTokens|number|true|none|This is the number of completion tokens generated in the analysis.|
|cachedPromptTokens|number|false|none|This is the number of cached prompt tokens used in the analysis. This is only applicable to certain providers (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI) that support prompt caching. Cached tokens are billed at a discounted rate.|
|reasoningTokens|number|false|none|This is the number of reasoning tokens generated in the analysis, reported only by reasoning models (e.g., GPT-5) on providers that report them. This is a subset of `completionTokens`, not an addition to it: reasoning tokens are already billed at the output-token rate, so this is for visibility only and does not affect `cost`.|
|structuredOutputBreakdown|[[StructuredOutputCostBreakdown](#schemastructuredoutputcostbreakdown)]|false|none|This is the per-structured-output breakdown of this cost. The `cost`, `promptTokens`, `completionTokens` and `cachedPromptTokens` above are the sums of these rows.<br><br>This is only set when `analysisType` is `structuredOutput`, and it is omitted entirely rather than partially populated, so when it is present the rows always reconcile to the totals above.<br><br>A structured output that was skipped, or that extracts via regex, makes no LLM call and so has no row here — this is not a complete list of the call's configured structured outputs. There is one row per evaluation, so a `structuredOutputId` can appear more than once if it was evaluated more than once; sum the rows rather than indexing them by id.|
|cost|number|true|none|This is the cost of the component in USD.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|messages|[[UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [BotMessage](#schemabotmessage) \| [ToolCallMessage](#schematoolcallmessage) \| [ToolCallResultMessage](#schematoolcallresultmessage)]|false|none|These are the messages that were spoken during the call.|
|messagesOpenAIFormatted|[[OpenAIMessage](#schemaopenaimessage)]|false|none|These are the messages that were spoken during the call, formatted for OpenAI.|
|skippedStructuredOutputs|object|false|none|Structured outputs skipped because their conditions were not met, keyed by saved or runtime output ID.|
|transfers|[[TransferArtifact](#schematransferartifact)]|false|none|These are the transfer records for the call's transfer attempts (warm and blind), including<br>destination, mode, and status. Warm transfer records also include transcripts and messages.|
|recordingUrl|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** This is the recording url for the call. To enable, set `assistant.artifactPlan.recordingEnabled`.|
|stereoRecordingUrl|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** This is the stereo recording url for the call. To enable, set `assistant.artifactPlan.recordingEnabled`.|
|videoRecordingUrl|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** This is video recording url for the call. To enable, set `assistant.artifactPlan.videoRecordingEnabled`.|
|videoRecordingStartDelaySeconds|number|false|none|**Deprecated.** This is video recording start delay in ms. To enable, set `assistant.artifactPlan.videoRecordingEnabled`. This can be used to align the playback of the recording with artifact.messages timestamps.|
|recording|object|false|none|This is the recording url for the call. To enable, set `assistant.artifactPlan.recordingEnabled`.|
|transcript|string|false|none|This is the transcript of the call. This is derived from `artifact.messages` but provided for convenience.|
|pcapUrl|string|false|none|This is the packet capture url for the call. This is only available for `phone` type calls where phone number's provider is `vapi` or `byo-phone-number`.|
|logUrl|string|false|none|This is the url for the call logs. This includes all logging output during the call for debugging purposes.|
|nodes|[[NodeArtifact](#schemanodeartifact)]|false|none|This is the history of workflow nodes that were executed during the call.|
|assistantActivations|[[AssistantActivation](#schemaassistantactivation)]|false|none|Ordered list of assistants that were active during the call, including after transfers and handoffs.|
|variableValues|object|false|none|These are the variable values at the end of the workflow execution.|
|performanceMetrics|object|false|none|This is the performance metrics for the call. It contains the turn latency, broken down by component.|
|structuredOutputs|object|false|none|These are the structured outputs that will be extracted from the call.<br>To enable, set `assistant.artifactPlan.structuredOutputIds` with the IDs of the structured outputs you want to extract.|
|scorecards|object|false|none|These are the scorecards that have been evaluated based on the structured outputs extracted during the call.<br>To enable, set `assistant.artifactPlan.scorecardIds` or `assistant.artifactPlan.scorecards` with the IDs or objects of the scorecards you want to evaluate.|
|structuredOutputsLastUpdatedAt|string(date-time)|false|none|This is when the structured outputs were last updated|
|presignedMonoUrl|string|false|none|This is a presigned URL to download the mono recording without<br>authentication. Populated on API responses and server messages; never<br>stored. Expires at `presignedUrlsExpiresAt` — after that, use<br>`GET /call/{id}/mono-recording`.|
|presignedStereoUrl|string|false|none|This is a presigned URL to download the stereo recording without<br>authentication. Expires at `presignedUrlsExpiresAt` — after that, use<br>`GET /call/{id}/stereo-recording`.|
|presignedVideoUrl|string|false|none|This is a presigned URL to download the video recording without<br>authentication. Expires at `presignedUrlsExpiresAt` — after that, use<br>`GET /call/{id}/video-recording`.|
|presignedAssistantUrl|string|false|none|This is a presigned URL to download the assistant-channel mono recording<br>without authentication. Expires at `presignedUrlsExpiresAt`.|
|presignedCustomerUrl|string|false|none|This is a presigned URL to download the customer-channel mono recording<br>without authentication. Expires at `presignedUrlsExpiresAt`.|
|presignedPcapUrl|string|false|none|This is a presigned URL to download the packet capture without<br>authentication. Expires at `presignedUrlsExpiresAt`.|
|presignedLogUrl|string|false|none|This is a presigned URL to download the call logs without<br>authentication. Expires at `presignedUrlsExpiresAt`.|
|presignedUrlsExpiresAt|string|false|none|This is when the presigned URLs above expire, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.<br>The raw `*Url` fields remain the stable identifiers and do not expire.<br>Presigned URLs are regenerated per response and per webhook delivery, so<br>values differ across retries.|

<h2 id="tocS_RecordingConsent">RecordingConsent</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemarecordingconsent"></a>
<a id="schema_RecordingConsent"></a>
<a id="tocSrecordingconsent"></a>
<a id="tocsrecordingconsent"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "stay-on-line",
  "grantedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of recording consent.|
|grantedAt|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the date and time the recording consent was granted.<br>If not specified, it means the recording consent was not granted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|stay-on-line|
|type|verbal|

```json
{
  "recordingConsent": {
    "type": "stay-on-line",
    "grantedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|recordingConsent|object|false|none|This is the recording consent of the call. Configure in `assistant.compliancePlan.recordingConsentPlan`.|

<h2 id="tocS_WorkflowOverrides">WorkflowOverrides</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaworkflowoverrides"></a>
<a id="schema_WorkflowOverrides"></a>
<a id="tocSworkflowoverrides"></a>
<a id="tocsworkflowoverrides"></a>

```json
{
  "variableValues": {}
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|variableValues|object|false|none|These are values that will be used to replace the template variables in the workflow messages and other text-based fields.<br>This uses LiquidJS syntax. https://liquidjs.com/tutorials/intro-to-liquid.html<br><br>So for example, `{{ name }}` will be replaced with the value of `name` in `variableValues`.<br>`{{"now" \| date: "%b %d, %Y, %I:%M %p", "America/New_York"}}` will be replaced with the current date and time in New York.<br> Some VAPI reserved defaults:<br> - *customer* - the customer object|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|numberE164CheckEnabled|boolean|false|none|This is the flag to toggle the E164 check for the `number` field. This is an advanced property which should be used if you know your use case requires it.<br><br>Use cases:<br>- `false`: To allow non-E164 numbers like `+001234567890`, `1234`, or `abc`. This is useful for dialing out to non-E164 numbers on your SIP trunks.<br>- `true` (default): To allow only E164 numbers like `+14155551234`. This is standard for PSTN calls.<br><br>If `false`, the `number` is still required to only contain alphanumeric characters (regex: `/^\+?[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/`).<br><br>@default true (E164 check is enabled)|
|extension|string|false|none|This is the extension that will be dialed after the call is answered.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the assistant's settings and template variables specific to this customer.<br>This allows customization of the assistant's behavior for individual customers in batch calls.|
|squadOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides applied when the call targets a `squadId`. Mirrors<br>the call-level `squadOverrides` — use this instead of `assistantOverrides`<br>when the campaign or call is squad-based.|
|number|string|false|none|This is the number of the customer.|
|sipUri|string|false|none|This is the SIP URI of the customer.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the customer. This is just for your own reference.<br><br>For SIP inbound calls, this is extracted from the `From` SIP header with format `"Display Name" <sip:username@domain>`.|
|email|string|false|none|This is the email of the customer.|
|externalId|string|false|none|This is the external ID of the customer.|

<h2 id="tocS_AssistantSpeechWordProgressTiming">AssistantSpeechWordProgressTiming</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaassistantspeechwordprogresstiming"></a>
<a id="schema_AssistantSpeechWordProgressTiming"></a>
<a id="tocSassistantspeechwordprogresstiming"></a>
<a id="tocsassistantspeechwordprogresstiming"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "word-progress",
  "wordsSpoken": 0,
  "totalWords": 0,
  "segment": "string",
  "segmentDurationMs": 0,
  "words": [
    {
      "word": "string",
      "startMs": 0,
      "endMs": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|Discriminator for cursor-based word progress (e.g. Minimax subtitle data).|
|wordsSpoken|number|true|none|Number of words spoken so far in this turn.|
|totalWords|number|true|none|Total number of words sent to the TTS provider for this turn.<br><br>**Important**: this value grows across events within a single turn because<br>Minimax synthesizes audio incrementally as the LLM streams tokens. Treat<br>it as "best known total so far" — it will stabilize once synthesis is<br>complete.<br><br>A value of `0` is a valid sentinel meaning "not yet known". This can occur<br>on the very first `assistant-speech` event of a turn if audio begins<br>playing before the TTS provider has confirmed word-count data. Clients<br>**must** guard against divide-by-zero when computing a progress fraction:<br><br>```ts<br>const pct = totalWords > 0 ? wordsSpoken / totalWords : 0;<br>```|
|segment|string|false|none|The text of the latest spoken segment (sentence or clause). Use this<br>for caption display — it corresponds to the chunk just confirmed by<br>the TTS provider, unlike `text` on the parent message which carries<br>the full turn text.|
|segmentDurationMs|number|false|none|Audio duration in milliseconds for the latest spoken segment. Pair<br>with `segment` to animate karaoke-style word reveals — divide the<br>segment text across this duration for approximate per-word timing.|
|words|[[AssistantSpeechWordTimestamp](#schemaassistantspeechwordtimestamp)]|false|none|Per-word timestamps for the latest spoken segment. Available when the<br>TTS provider supports word-level timing (e.g. Minimax with<br>subtitle_type: "word"). Syllables from the provider are aggregated<br>into whole words with start/end times relative to the segment start.<br><br>Use these for precise karaoke-style highlighting instead of<br>interpolating from segmentDurationMs.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|word-progress|

```json
{
  "type": "oneOf",
  "key": "call.endedReason",
  "oneOf": "assistant-request-failed"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of filter - currently only "oneOf" is supported|
|key|string|true|none|This is the key to filter on - only "call.endedReason" is allowed for phone number call ending hooks|
|oneOf|[string]|true|none|This is the array of assistant-request related ended reasons to match against|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|oneOf|
|key|call.endedReason|
|oneOf|assistant-request-failed|
|oneOf|assistant-request-returned-error|
|oneOf|assistant-request-returned-unspeakable-error|
|oneOf|assistant-request-returned-invalid-assistant|
|oneOf|assistant-request-returned-no-assistant|
|oneOf|assistant-request-returned-forwarding-phone-number|

```json
        "transferCompleteAudioUrl": "string",
        "contextEngineeringPlan": {
          "type": "lastNMessages",
          "maxMessages": 0
        },
        "twiml": "string",
        "summaryPlan": {
          "messages": [
            {}
          ],
          "enabled": true,
          "timeoutSeconds": 1
        },
        "sipHeadersInReferToEnabled": true,
        "fallbackPlan": {
          "message": "string",
          "endCallEnabled": true
        }
      },
      "name": "string",
      "description": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|on|string|true|none|This is the event to trigger the hook on|
|filters|[[PhoneNumberCallEndingHookFilter](#schemaphonenumbercallendinghookfilter)]|false|none|Optional filters to decide when to trigger - restricted to assistant-request related ended reasons|
|do|[TransferPhoneNumberHookAction](#schematransferphonenumberhookaction) \| [SayPhoneNumberHookAction](#schemasayphonenumberhookaction)|false|none|This is the action to perform when the hook triggers|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|on|call.ending|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fallbackDestination|[TransferDestinationNumber](#schematransferdestinationnumber) \| [TransferDestinationSip](#schematransferdestinationsip)|false|none|This is the fallback destination an inbound call will be transferred to if:<br>1. `assistantId` is not set<br>2. `squadId` is not set<br>3. and, `assistant-request` message to the `serverUrl` fails<br><br>If this is not set and above conditions are met, the inbound call is hung up with an error message.|
|hooks|[[PhoneNumberHookCallRinging](#schemaphonenumberhookcallringing) \| [PhoneNumberHookCallEnding](#schemaphonenumberhookcallending)]|false|none|This is the hooks that will be used for incoming calls to this phone number.|
|smsEnabled|boolean|false|none|Controls whether Vapi sets the messaging webhook URL on the Twilio number during import.<br><br>If set to `false`, Vapi will not update the Twilio messaging URL, leaving it as is.<br>If `true` or omitted (default), Vapi will configure both the voice and messaging URLs.<br><br>@default true|
|twilioPhoneNumber|string|true|none|**Deprecated.** These are the digits of the phone number you own on your Twilio.|
|twilioAccountSid|string|true|none|This is your Twilio Account SID that will be used to handle this phone number.|
|twilioAuthToken|string|false|none|This is the Twilio Auth Token that will be used to handle this phone number.|
|twilioApiKey|string|false|none|This is the Twilio API Key that will be used to handle this phone number. If AuthToken is provided, this will be ignored.|
|twilioApiSecret|string|false|none|This is the Twilio API Secret that will be used to handle this phone number. If AuthToken is provided, this will be ignored.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the phone number. This is just for your own reference.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for incoming calls to this phone number.<br><br>If neither `assistantId`, `squadId` nor `workflowId` is set, `assistant-request` will be sent to your Server URL. Check `ServerMessage` and `ServerMessageResponse` for the shape of the message and response that is expected.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the workflow that will be used for incoming calls to this phone number.<br><br>If neither `assistantId`, `squadId`, nor `workflowId` is set, `assistant-request` will be sent to your Server URL. Check `ServerMessage` and `ServerMessageResponse` for the shape of the message and response that is expected.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for incoming calls to this phone number.<br><br>If neither `assistantId`, `squadId`, nor `workflowId` is set, `assistant-request` will be sent to your Server URL. Check `ServerMessage` and `ServerMessageResponse` for the shape of the message and response that is expected.|
|server|object|false|none|This is where Vapi will send webhooks. You can find all webhooks available along with their shape in ServerMessage schema.<br><br>The order of precedence is:<br><br>1. assistant.server<br>2. phoneNumber.server<br>3. org.server|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the assistant version to use for this call. Supported only with<br>direct `assistantId`. Omit to follow the latest version.|
|squadVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the squad version to use for this call. Supported only with<br>direct `squadId`. Omit to follow the latest version.|
|transport|[VapiWebsocketTransport](#schemavapiwebsockettransport) \| [VonageTransport](#schemavonagetransport) \| [TwilioTransport](#schematwiliotransport) \| [VapiSipTransport](#schemavapisiptransport) \| [TelnyxTransport](#schematelnyxtransport) \| [VapiWebCallTransport](#schemavapiwebcalltransport)|false|none|This is the transport of the call.|
|customers|[[CreateCustomerDTO](#schemacreatecustomerdto)]|false|none|This is used to issue batch calls to multiple customers.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall`. To call a single customer, use `customer` instead.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the call. This is just for your own reference.|
|schedulePlan|object|false|none|This is the schedule plan of the call.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID that will be used for the call. To use a transient assistant, use `assistant` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistantId` or `assistant`<br>- Squad, use `squadId` or `squad`<br>- Workflow, use `workflowId` or `workflow`|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the call. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant`<br>- Squad, use `squad`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow`|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `assistant` or `assistantId`'s settings and template variables.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the call. To use a transient squad, use `squad` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|squad|object|false|none|This is a squad that will be used for the call. To use an existing squad, use `squadId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|squadOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `squad` or `squadId`'s member settings and template variables.<br>This will apply to all members of the squad.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the workflow that will be used for the call. To use a transient workflow, use `workflow` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|workflow|object|false|none|This is a workflow that will be used for the call. To use an existing workflow, use `workflowId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|workflowOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `workflow` or `workflowId`'s settings and template variables.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the phone number that will be used for the call. To use a transient number, use `phoneNumber` instead.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall` and `inboundPhoneCall` type.|
|phoneNumber|object|false|none|This is the phone number that will be used for the call. To use an existing number, use `phoneNumberId` instead.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall` and `inboundPhoneCall` type.|
|customerId|string|false|none|This is the customer that will be called. To call a transient customer , use `customer` instead.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall` and `inboundPhoneCall` type.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that will be called. To call an existing customer, use `customerId` instead.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall` and `inboundPhoneCall` type.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the assistant version to use for this call. Supported only with<br>direct `assistantId`. Omit to follow the latest version.|
|squadVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the squad version to use for this call. Supported only with<br>direct `squadId`. Omit to follow the latest version.|
|transport|[VapiWebsocketTransport](#schemavapiwebsockettransport) \| [VonageTransport](#schemavonagetransport) \| [TwilioTransport](#schematwiliotransport) \| [VapiSipTransport](#schemavapisiptransport) \| [TelnyxTransport](#schematelnyxtransport) \| [VapiWebCallTransport](#schemavapiwebcalltransport)|false|none|This is the transport of the call.|
|customers|[[CreateCustomerDTO](#schemacreatecustomerdto)]|false|none|This is used to issue batch calls to multiple customers.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall`. To call a single customer, use `customer` instead.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the call. This is just for your own reference.|
|schedulePlan|object|false|none|This is the schedule plan of the call.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID that will be used for the call. To use a transient assistant, use `assistant` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistantId` or `assistant`<br>- Squad, use `squadId` or `squad`<br>- Workflow, use `workflowId` or `workflow`|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the call. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant`<br>- Squad, use `squad`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow`|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `assistant` or `assistantId`'s settings and template variables.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the call. To use a transient squad, use `squad` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|squad|object|false|none|This is a squad that will be used for the call. To use an existing squad, use `squadId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|squadOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `squad` or `squadId`'s member settings and template variables.<br>This will apply to all members of the squad.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the workflow that will be used for the call. To use a transient workflow, use `workflow` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|workflow|object|false|none|This is a workflow that will be used for the call. To use an existing workflow, use `workflowId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|workflowOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `workflow` or `workflowId`'s settings and template variables.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the phone number that will be used for the call. To use a transient number, use `phoneNumber` instead.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall` and `inboundPhoneCall` type.|
|phoneNumber|object|false|none|This is the phone number that will be used for the call. To use an existing number, use `phoneNumberId` instead.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall` and `inboundPhoneCall` type.|
|customerId|string|false|none|This is the customer that will be called. To call a transient customer , use `customer` instead.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall` and `inboundPhoneCall` type.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that will be called. To call an existing customer, use `customerId` instead.<br><br>Only relevant for `outboundPhoneCall` and `inboundPhoneCall` type.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the assistant version to use for this call. Supported only with<br>direct `assistantId`. Omit to follow the latest version.|
|squadVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the squad version to use for this call. Supported only with<br>direct `squadId`. Omit to follow the latest version.|
|roomDeleteOnUserLeaveEnabled|boolean|false|none|none|
|videoRecordingStartMode|string|false|none|This determines who starts the video recording. Only applies when video<br>recording is enabled (`artifactPlan.videoRecordingEnabled`).<br><br>- `client`: the web client starts the recording when it joins.<br>- `server`: Vapi starts the recording once when the user first joins, so a<br>  weak client connection can't stop it from starting. The returned<br>  `transport.callToken` doesn't start the recording, and the client should<br>  not start it either. If Vapi can't set up the server-side start, no token<br>  is returned. If the start itself fails, the client is told during the<br>  call.<br><br>Defaults to `client`.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID that will be used for the call. To use a transient assistant, use `assistant` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistantId` or `assistant`<br>- Squad, use `squadId` or `squad`<br>- Workflow, use `workflowId` or `workflow`|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the call. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant`<br>- Squad, use `squad`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow`|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `assistant` or `assistantId`'s settings and template variables.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the call. To use a transient squad, use `squad` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|squad|object|false|none|This is a squad that will be used for the call. To use an existing squad, use `squadId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|squadOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `squad` or `squadId`'s member settings and template variables.<br>This will apply to all members of the squad.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the workflow that will be used for the call. To use a transient workflow, use `workflow` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|workflow|object|false|none|This is a workflow that will be used for the call. To use an existing workflow, use `workflowId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|workflowOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `workflow` or `workflowId`'s settings and template variables.|


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the chat. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the chat. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the variable values that will be used to replace template variables in the assistant messages.<br>Only variable substitution is supported in chat contexts - other assistant properties cannot be overridden.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the chat. To use a transient squad, use `squad` instead.|
|squad|object|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the chat. To use an existing squad, use `squadId` instead.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the chat. This is just for your own reference.|
|sessionId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the session that will be used for the chat.<br>Mutually exclusive with previousChatId.|
|input|string \| [[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|false|none|This is the input text for the chat.<br>Can be a string or an array of chat messages.|
|stream|boolean|false|none|This is a flag that determines whether the response should be streamed.<br>When true, the response will be sent as chunks of text.|
|previousChatId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the chat that will be used as context for the new chat.<br>The messages from the previous chat will be used as context.<br>Mutually exclusive with sessionId.|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the chat.|
|orgId|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the org that this chat belongs to.|
|messages|[[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|false|none|This is an array of messages used as context for the chat.<br>Used to provide message history for multi-turn conversations.|
|output|[[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|false|none|This is the output messages generated by the system in response to the input.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the chat was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the chat was last updated.|
|costs|[[ModelCost](#schemamodelcost) \| [ChatCost](#schemachatcost)]|false|none|These are the costs of individual components of the chat in USD.|
|cost|number|false|none|This is the cost of the chat in USD.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|conversationType|string|false|none|This is the conversation type of the call (ie, voice or chat).|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the phone number that will be used to send the SMS.<br>If provided, will create a new session. If not provided, uses existing session's phoneNumberId.<br>The phone number must have SMS enabled and belong to your organization.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer who will receive the SMS.<br>If provided, will create a new session. If not provided, uses existing session's customer.|
|customerId|string|false|none|This is the customerId of the customer who will receive the SMS.|
|useLLMGeneratedMessageForOutbound|boolean|false|none|Whether to use LLM-generated messages for outbound SMS.<br>When true (default), input is processed by the assistant for a response.<br>When false, the input text is forwarded directly as the SMS message without LLM processing.<br>Useful for sending pre-defined messages or notifications.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of transport to use for sending the chat response.<br>Currently supports 'twilio.sms' for SMS delivery via Twilio.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|conversationType|chat|
|type|twilio.sms|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the chat. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the chat. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the variable values that will be used to replace template variables in the assistant messages.<br>Only variable substitution is supported in chat contexts - other assistant properties cannot be overridden.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the chat. To use a transient squad, use `squad` instead.|
|squad|object|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the chat. To use an existing squad, use `squadId` instead.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the chat. This is just for your own reference.|
|sessionId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the session that will be used for the chat.<br>Mutually exclusive with previousChatId.|
|input|string \| [[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|true|none|This is the input text for the chat.<br>Can be a string or an array of chat messages.<br>This field is REQUIRED for chat creation.|
|stream|boolean|false|none|This is a flag that determines whether the response should be streamed.<br>When true, the response will be sent as chunks of text.|
|previousChatId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the chat that will be used as context for the new chat.<br>The messages from the previous chat will be used as context.<br>Mutually exclusive with sessionId.|
|transport|object|false|none|This is used to send the chat through a transport like SMS.<br>If transport.phoneNumberId and transport.customer are provided, creates a new session.<br>If sessionId is provided without transport fields, uses existing session data.<br>Cannot specify both sessionId and transport fields (phoneNumberId/customer) together.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|This is the unique identifier for the chat to filter by.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the unique identifier for the assistant that will be used for the chat.|
|assistantIdAny|string|false|none|Filter by multiple assistant IDs. Provide as comma-separated values.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the unique identifier for the squad that will be used for the chat.|
|sessionId|string|false|none|This is the unique identifier for the session that will be used for the chat.|
|previousChatId|string|false|none|This is the unique identifier for the previous chat to filter by.|
|idAny|string|false|none|Filter by multiple chat IDs. Provide as comma-separated values.|
|page|number|false|none|This is the page number to return. Defaults to 1.|
|sortOrder|string|false|none|This is the sort order for pagination. Defaults to 'DESC'.|
|sortBy|string|false|none|This is the column to sort by. Defaults to 'createdAt'.|
|limit|number|false|none|This is the maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.|
|createdAtGt|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than the specified value.|
|createdAtLt|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the createdAt is less than the specified value.|
|createdAtGe|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|createdAtLe|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the createdAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtGt|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than the specified value.|
|updatedAtLt|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than the specified value.|
|updatedAtGe|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtLe|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|sortOrder|ASC|
|sortOrder|DESC|
|sortBy|createdAt|
|sortBy|duration|
|sortBy|cost|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the streaming response.|
|sessionId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the session that will be used for the chat.<br>Helps track conversation context across multiple messages.|
|path|string|true|none|This is the path to the content being updated.<br>Format: `chat.output[{contentIndex}].content` where contentIndex identifies the specific content item.|
|delta|string|true|none|This is the incremental content chunk being streamed.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the chat. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the chat. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the variable values that will be used to replace template variables in the assistant messages.<br>Only variable substitution is supported in chat contexts - other assistant properties cannot be overridden.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the chat. To use a transient squad, use `squad` instead.|
|squad|object|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the chat. To use an existing squad, use `squadId` instead.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the chat. This is just for your own reference.|
|sessionId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the session that will be used for the chat.<br>Mutually exclusive with previousChatId.|
|input|string \| [[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|true|none|This is the input text for the chat.<br>Can be a string or an array of chat messages.<br>This field is REQUIRED for chat creation.|
|stream|boolean|false|none|Whether to stream the response or not.|
|previousChatId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the chat that will be used as context for the new chat.<br>The messages from the previous chat will be used as context.<br>Mutually exclusive with sessionId.|
|transport|object|false|none|This is used to send the chat through a transport like SMS.<br>If transport.phoneNumberId and transport.customer are provided, creates a new session.<br>If sessionId is provided without transport fields, uses existing session data.<br>Cannot specify both sessionId and transport fields (phoneNumberId/customer) together.|

<h2 id="tocS_CreateWebCustomerDTO">CreateWebCustomerDTO</h2>

```json
{
  "numberE164CheckEnabled": true,
  "extension": null,
  "assistantOverrides": {
    "variableValues": {
      "name": "John",
      "company": "ACME Corp"
    }
  },
  "number": "string",
  "sipUri": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "externalId": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|numberE164CheckEnabled|boolean|false|none|This is the flag to toggle the E164 check for the `number` field. This is an advanced property which should be used if you know your use case requires it.<br><br>Use cases:<br>- `false`: To allow non-E164 numbers like `+001234567890`, `1234`, or `abc`. This is useful for dialing out to non-E164 numbers on your SIP trunks.<br>- `true` (default): To allow only E164 numbers like `+14155551234`. This is standard for PSTN calls.<br><br>If `false`, the `number` is still required to only contain alphanumeric characters (regex: `/^\+?[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/`).<br><br>@default true (E164 check is enabled)|
|extension|string|false|none|This is the extension that will be dialed after the call is answered.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the variable values that will be used to replace template variables in the assistant messages.<br>Only variable substitution is supported in web chat - other assistant properties cannot be overridden.|
|number|string|false|none|This is the number of the customer.|
|sipUri|string|false|none|This is the SIP URI of the customer.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the customer. This is just for your own reference.<br><br>For SIP inbound calls, this is extracted from the `From` SIP header with format `"Display Name" <sip:username@domain>`.|
|email|string|false|none|This is the email of the customer.|
|externalId|string|false|none|This is the external ID of the customer.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID to use for this chat. To use a transient assistant, use `assistant` instead.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the transient assistant configuration for this chat. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.|
|sessionId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the session that will be used for the chat.<br>If provided, the conversation will continue from the previous state.<br>If not provided or expired, a new session will be created.|
|sessionExpirationSeconds|number|false|none|This is the expiration time for the session. This can ONLY be set if starting a new chat and therefore a new session is created.<br>If session already exists, this will be ignored and NOT be updated for the existing session. Use PATCH /session/:id to update the session expiration time.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the variable values that will be used to replace template variables in the assistant messages.<br>Only variable substitution is supported in web chat - other assistant properties cannot be overridden.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer information for the chat.<br>Used to automatically manage sessions for repeat customers.|
|input|string \| [[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|true|none|This is the input text for the chat.<br>Can be a string or an array of chat messages.|
|stream|boolean|false|none|This is a flag that determines whether the response should be streamed.<br>When true, the response will be sent as chunks of text.|
|sessionEnd|boolean|false|none|This is a flag to indicate end of session. When true, the session will be marked as completed and the chat will be ended.<br>Used to end session to send End-of-session report to the customer.<br>When flag is set to true, any messages sent will not be processed and session will directly be marked as completed.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the chat.|
|sessionId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the session for the chat. Send it in the next chat request to continue the conversation.|
|output|[[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|true|none|This is the output messages generated by the system in response to the input.|

```json
  "stream": true,
  "sessionEnd": false
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID to use for this chat. To use a transient assistant, use `assistant` instead.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the transient assistant configuration for this chat. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.|
|sessionId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the session that will be used for the chat.<br>If provided, the conversation will continue from the previous state.<br>If not provided or expired, a new session will be created.|
|sessionExpirationSeconds|number|false|none|This is the expiration time for the session. This can ONLY be set if starting a new chat and therefore a new session is created.<br>If session already exists, this will be ignored and NOT be updated for the existing session. Use PATCH /session/:id to update the session expiration time.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the variable values that will be used to replace template variables in the assistant messages.<br>Only variable substitution is supported in web chat - other assistant properties cannot be overridden.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer information for the chat.<br>Used to automatically manage sessions for repeat customers.|
|input|string \| [[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|true|none|This is the input text for the chat.<br>Can be a string or an array of chat messages.|
|stream|boolean|false|none|Whether to stream the response or not.|
|sessionEnd|boolean|false|none|This is a flag to indicate end of session. When true, the session will be marked as completed and the chat will be ended.<br>Used to end session to send End-of-session report to the customer.<br>When flag is set to true, any messages sent will not be processed and session will directly be marked as completed.|


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|This is the name of the campaign. This is just for your own reference.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Note: Only one of assistantId, workflowId, or squadId can be used.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the workflow ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Note: Only one of assistantId, workflowId, or squadId can be used.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Note: Only one of assistantId, workflowId, or squadId can be used.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the phone number ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Required if dialPlan is not provided. Note: phoneNumberId and dialPlan are mutually exclusive.|
|dialPlan|[[DialPlanEntry](#schemadialplanentry)]|false|none|This is a list of dial entries, each specifying a phone number and the customers to call using that number. Use this when you want different phone numbers to call different sets of customers. Note: phoneNumberId and dialPlan are mutually exclusive.|
|schedulePlan|object|false|none|This is the schedule plan for the campaign. Calls will start at startedAt and continue until your organization’s concurrency limit is reached. Any remaining calls will be retried for up to one hour as capacity becomes available. After that hour or after latestAt, whichever comes first, any calls that couldn’t be placed won’t be retried.|
|customers|[[CreateCustomerDTO](#schemacreatecustomerdto)]|false|none|These are the customers that will be called in the campaign. Required if dialPlan is not provided. Maximum of 10000 customers per campaign.|
|maxConcurrency|number|false|none|This is the maximum number of concurrent calls that will be made for the campaign. Defaults to 10. Maximum of 500, and may not exceed your organization's concurrency limit.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the assistant's settings and template variables for the campaign. Use this when the campaign targets an `assistantId`.|
|squadOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the squad and template variables for the campaign. Use this when the campaign targets a `squadId`. Per-contact `squadOverrides` are deep-merged on top of this at dispatch time.|
|server|object|false|none|This is the server (URL, auth headers, timeout, etc.) for the campaign webhooks.|
|serverMessages|[string]|false|none|These are the messages that will be sent to your Server URL.|
|predialPlan|object|false|none|This opts the campaign into the blocking `campaign.predial` eligibility webhook. When set, every contact triggers a `campaign.predial` POST to the Server URL before dialing, and the response `{ eligible: boolean }` decides whether the call is placed. Requires `server`. When unset, no pre-dial webhook is sent.|
|duplicateFromCampaignId|string|false|none|Optional campaign ID to duplicate config from. Provided fields in the request override the source. If `customers` is omitted, contacts are copied from the source.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|serverMessages|campaign.started|
|serverMessages|campaign.cancelled|
|serverMessages|campaign.ended|
|serverMessages|campaign.archived|
|serverMessages|campaign.unarchived|
|serverMessages|contact.dispatched|
|serverMessages|contact.completed|
|serverMessages|contact.failed|
|serverMessages|contact.skipped|
|serverMessages|contact.predial-failed|
|serverMessages|campaign.job.continued|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|string|true|none|This is the status of the campaign.|
|endedReason|string|false|none|This is the explanation for how the campaign ended.|
|name|string|true|none|This is the name of the campaign. This is just for your own reference.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Note: Only one of assistantId, workflowId, or squadId can be used.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the workflow ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Note: Only one of assistantId, workflowId, or squadId can be used.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Note: Only one of assistantId, workflowId, or squadId can be used.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the phone number ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Required if dialPlan is not provided. Note: phoneNumberId and dialPlan are mutually exclusive.|
|dialPlan|[[DialPlanEntry](#schemadialplanentry)]|false|none|This is a list of dial entries, each specifying a phone number and the customers to call using that number. Use this when you want different phone numbers to call different sets of customers. Note: phoneNumberId and dialPlan are mutually exclusive.|
|schedulePlan|object|false|none|This is the schedule plan for the campaign. Calls will start at startedAt and continue until your organization’s concurrency limit is reached. Any remaining calls will be retried for up to one hour as capacity becomes available. After that hour or after latestAt, whichever comes first, any calls that couldn’t be placed won’t be retried.|
|customers|[[CreateCustomerDTO](#schemacreatecustomerdto)]|false|none|These are the customers that will be called in the campaign. Required if dialPlan is not provided. Maximum of 10000 customers per campaign.|
|maxConcurrency|number|false|none|This is the maximum number of concurrent calls that will be made for the campaign. Defaults to 10. Maximum of 500, and may not exceed your organization's concurrency limit.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the assistant's settings and template variables for the campaign. Use this when the campaign targets an `assistantId`.|
|squadOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the squad and template variables for the campaign. Use this when the campaign targets a `squadId`. Per-contact `squadOverrides` are deep-merged on top of this at dispatch time.|
|server|object|false|none|This is the server (URL, auth headers, timeout, etc.) for the campaign webhooks.|
|serverMessages|[string]|false|none|These are the messages that will be sent to your Server URL.|
|predialPlan|object|false|none|This opts the campaign into the blocking `campaign.predial` eligibility webhook. When set, every contact triggers a `campaign.predial` POST to the Server URL before dialing, and the response `{ eligible: boolean }` decides whether the call is placed. Requires `server`. When unset, no pre-dial webhook is sent.|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the campaign.|
|orgId|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the org that this campaign belongs to.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the campaign was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the campaign was last updated.|
|calls|object|true|none|This is a map of call IDs to campaign call details.|
|callsCounterScheduled|number|true|none|This is the number of calls that have been scheduled.|
|callsCounterQueued|number|true|none|This is the number of calls that have been queued.|
|callsCounterInProgress|number|true|none|This is the number of calls that have been in progress.|
|callsCounterEndedVoicemail|number|true|none|This is the number of calls whose ended reason is 'voicemail'.|
|callsCounterEnded|number|true|none|This is the number of calls that have ended.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|scheduled|
|status|in-progress|
|status|ended|
|status|cancelled|
|status|archived|
|endedReason|campaign.scheduled.ended-by-user|
|endedReason|campaign.in-progress.ended-by-user|
|endedReason|campaign.ended.success|
|serverMessages|campaign.started|
|serverMessages|campaign.cancelled|
|serverMessages|campaign.ended|
|serverMessages|campaign.archived|
|serverMessages|campaign.unarchived|
|serverMessages|contact.dispatched|
|serverMessages|contact.completed|
|serverMessages|contact.failed|
|serverMessages|contact.skipped|
|serverMessages|contact.predial-failed|
|serverMessages|campaign.job.continued|

<h2 id="tocS_CampaignCallMetrics">CampaignCallMetrics</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacampaigncallmetrics"></a>
<a id="schema_CampaignCallMetrics"></a>
<a id="tocScampaigncallmetrics"></a>
<a id="tocscampaigncallmetrics"></a>

```json
{
  "dialed": 0,
  "connected": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|dialed|number|true|none|This is the number of contacts a call was actually placed for. Contacts<br>that were skipped, rejected before dialing, or failed to dispatch are not<br>counted — no call existed, so there was nothing to answer.|
|connected|number|true|none|This is the number of those calls a human picked up. Voicemail does not<br>count. Divide by `dialed` for the pick-up rate.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|string|true|none|This is the status of the campaign.|
|endedReason|string|false|none|This is the explanation for how the campaign ended.|
|name|string|true|none|This is the name of the campaign. This is just for your own reference.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Note: Only one of assistantId, workflowId, or squadId can be used.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Note: Only one of assistantId, workflowId, or squadId can be used.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the phone number ID that will be used for the campaign calls. Required if dialPlan is not provided. Note: phoneNumberId and dialPlan are mutually exclusive.|
|schedulePlan|object|false|none|This is the schedule plan for the campaign. Calls will start at startedAt and continue until your organization’s concurrency limit is reached. Any remaining calls will be retried for up to one hour as capacity becomes available. After that hour or after latestAt, whichever comes first, any calls that couldn’t be placed won’t be retried.|
|maxConcurrency|number|false|none|This is the maximum number of concurrent calls that will be made for the campaign. Defaults to 10. Maximum of 500, and may not exceed your organization's concurrency limit.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the assistant's settings and template variables for the campaign. Use this when the campaign targets an `assistantId`.|
|squadOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the squad and template variables for the campaign. Use this when the campaign targets a `squadId`. Per-contact `squadOverrides` are deep-merged on top of this at dispatch time.|
|server|object|false|none|This is the server (URL, auth headers, timeout, etc.) for the campaign webhooks.|
|serverMessages|[string]|false|none|These are the messages that will be sent to your Server URL.|
|predialPlan|object|false|none|This opts the campaign into the blocking `campaign.predial` eligibility webhook. When set, every contact triggers a `campaign.predial` POST to the Server URL before dialing, and the response `{ eligible: boolean }` decides whether the call is placed. Requires `server`. When unset, no pre-dial webhook is sent.|
|contactCounters|object|false|none|These are the per-status contact counts for this campaign. Sum them for the<br>campaign's total audience; `pending` plus `dispatched` is what is left to<br>complete.|
|callMetrics|object|false|none|These are the call-level outcomes for this campaign — how many contacts<br>were actually dialed, and how many of those a human picked up.|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the campaign.|
|orgId|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the org that this campaign belongs to.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the campaign was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the campaign was last updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|scheduled|
|status|in-progress|
|status|ended|
|status|cancelled|
|status|archived|
|endedReason|campaign.scheduled.ended-by-user|
|endedReason|campaign.in-progress.ended-by-user|
|endedReason|campaign.ended.success|
|serverMessages|campaign.started|
|serverMessages|campaign.cancelled|
|serverMessages|campaign.ended|
|serverMessages|campaign.archived|
|serverMessages|campaign.unarchived|
|serverMessages|contact.dispatched|
|serverMessages|contact.completed|
|serverMessages|contact.failed|
|serverMessages|contact.skipped|
|serverMessages|contact.predial-failed|
|serverMessages|campaign.job.continued|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the campaign. This is just for your own reference.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the assistant ID that will be used for the campaign calls.<br>Can only be updated if campaign is not in progress or has ended.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the workflow ID that will be used for the campaign calls.<br>Can only be updated if campaign is not in progress or has ended.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad ID that will be used for the campaign calls.<br>Can only be updated if campaign is not in progress or has ended.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the phone number ID that will be used for the campaign calls.<br>Can only be updated if campaign is not in progress or has ended.<br>Note: `phoneNumberId` and `dialPlan` are mutually exclusive.|
|dialPlan|[[DialPlanEntry](#schemadialplanentry)]|false|none|This is a list of dial entries, each specifying a phone number and the customers to call using that number. Can only be updated if campaign is not in progress or has ended. Note: phoneNumberId and dialPlan are mutually exclusive.|
|schedulePlan|object|false|none|This is the schedule plan for the campaign.<br>Can only be updated if campaign is not in progress or has ended.|
|status|string|false|none|Set to 'cancelled' to stop the campaign ('ended' is a V1 alias). Scheduled<br>calls are deleted; in-progress calls are allowed to finish.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|ended|
|status|cancelled|


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the session.|
|orgId|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the organization that owns this session.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the session was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the session was last updated.|
|cost|number|false|none|This is the cost of the session in USD.|
|costs|[[ModelCost](#schemamodelcost) \| [AnalysisCost](#schemaanalysiscost) \| [SessionCost](#schemasessioncost)]|false|none|These are the costs of individual components of the session in USD.|
|name|string|false|none|This is a user-defined name for the session. Maximum length is 40 characters.|
|status|string|false|none|This is the current status of the session. Can be either 'active' or 'completed'.|
|expirationSeconds|number|false|none|Session expiration time in seconds. Defaults to 24 hours (86400 seconds) if not set.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the assistant associated with this session. Use this when referencing an existing assistant.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant configuration for this session. Use this when creating a new assistant configuration.<br>If assistantId is provided, this will be ignored.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the assistant configuration.<br>Use this to provide variable values and other overrides when using assistantId.<br>Variable substitution will be applied to the assistant's messages and other text-based fields.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad ID associated with this session. Use this when referencing an existing squad.|
|squad|object|false|none|This is the squad configuration for this session. Use this when creating a new squad configuration.<br>If squadId is provided, this will be ignored.|
|messages|[[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|false|none|This is an array of chat messages in the session.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer information associated with this session.|
|customerId|string|false|none|This is the customerId of the customer associated with this session.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the phone number associated with this session.|
|phoneNumber|object|false|none|This is the phone number configuration for this session.|
|artifact|object|false|none|These are the artifacts that were extracted from the session messages.<br>They are only available after the session has completed.<br>The artifact plan from the assistant or active assistant of squad is used to generate the artifact.<br>Currently the only supported fields of assistant artifact plan are:<br>- structuredOutputIds|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|completed|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|false|none|This is a user-defined name for the session. Maximum length is 40 characters.|
|status|string|false|none|This is the current status of the session. Can be either 'active' or 'completed'.|
|expirationSeconds|number|false|none|Session expiration time in seconds. Defaults to 24 hours (86400 seconds) if not set.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the assistant associated with this session. Use this when referencing an existing assistant.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant configuration for this session. Use this when creating a new assistant configuration.<br>If assistantId is provided, this will be ignored.|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the assistant configuration.<br>Use this to provide variable values and other overrides when using assistantId.<br>Variable substitution will be applied to the assistant's messages and other text-based fields.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad ID associated with this session. Use this when referencing an existing squad.|
|squad|object|false|none|This is the squad configuration for this session. Use this when creating a new squad configuration.<br>If squadId is provided, this will be ignored.|
|messages|[[SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [AssistantMessage](#schemaassistantmessage) \| [ToolMessage](#schematoolmessage) \| [DeveloperMessage](#schemadevelopermessage)]|false|none|This is an array of chat messages in the session.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer information associated with this session.|
|customerId|string|false|none|This is the customerId of the customer associated with this session.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the phone number associated with this session.|
|phoneNumber|object|false|none|This is the phone number configuration for this session.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|completed|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|This is the unique identifier for the session to filter by.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the session to filter by.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the assistant to filter sessions by.|
|assistantIdAny|string|false|none|Filter by multiple assistant IDs. Provide as comma-separated values.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the squad to filter sessions by.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the workflow to filter sessions by.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer information to filter by.|
|customerNumberAny|string|false|none|Filter by any of the specified customer phone numbers (comma-separated).|
|idAny|string|false|none|Filter by multiple session IDs. Provide as comma-separated values.|
|phoneNumberId|string|false|none|This will return sessions with the specified phoneNumberId.|
|phoneNumberIdAny|[string]|false|none|This will return sessions with any of the specified phoneNumberIds.|
|page|number|false|none|This is the page number to return. Defaults to 1.|
|sortOrder|string|false|none|This is the sort order for pagination. Defaults to 'DESC'.|
|sortBy|string|false|none|This is the column to sort by. Defaults to 'createdAt'.|
|limit|number|false|none|This is the maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.|
|createdAtGt|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than the specified value.|
|createdAtLt|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the createdAt is less than the specified value.|
|createdAtGe|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the createdAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|createdAtLe|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the createdAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtGt|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than the specified value.|
|updatedAtLt|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than the specified value.|
|updatedAtGe|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.|
|updatedAtLe|string(date-time)|false|none|This will return items where the updatedAt is less than or equal to the specified value.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|sortOrder|ASC|
|sortOrder|DESC|
|sortBy|createdAt|
|sortBy|duration|
|sortBy|cost|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistantId|string|true|none|The assistant whose calls this allocation splits.|

|expectedCurrentAllocationId|string(uuid)|false|none|Optional concurrency guard. Omit it and the write applies unconditionally (last write wins, matching every other Vapi update surface). Provide the id of the allocation you last read and the write applies only while that allocation is still governing; any mismatch is a 409 carrying the actual current id.|
|description|string|false|none|An optional note explaining why you made this change.|

|allocationIntent|explicit|

|assistantVersionId|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|none|
|assistantVersionLabel|string \| null|false|none|The published version label, such as "v7". Null when no version row resolves (unversioned calls, or a since-purged version).|

|timeseries|[[TrafficTabTimeseriesPointDTO](#schematraffictabtimeseriespointdto)]|true|none|none|
|structuredOutputs|[[TrafficTabStructuredOutputDTO](#schematraffictabstructuredoutputdto)]|false|none|Present only when structuredOutputIds was given.|
