### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the subscription.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the timestamp when the subscription was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the timestamp when the subscription was last updated.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|This is the display name for the subscription, used to tell subscriptions<br>apart in the dashboard. It is unique across all subscriptions and does not<br>appear on invoices, which use the company details on the invoice plan.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type / tier of the subscription.|
|status|string|true|none|This is the status of the subscription. Past due subscriptions are subscriptions<br>with past due payments.|
|credits|string|true|none|This is the number of credits the subscription currently has.<br><br>Note: This is a string to avoid floating point precision issues.|
|concurrencyCounter|number|true|none|This is the total number of active calls (concurrency) across all orgs under this subscription.|
|concurrencyLimitIncluded|number|true|none|This is the default concurrency limit for the subscription.|
|phoneNumbersCounter|number|false|none|This is the number of free phone numbers the subscription has|
|phoneNumbersIncluded|number|false|none|This is the maximum number of free phone numbers the subscription can have|
|concurrencyLimitPurchased|number|true|none|This is the purchased add-on concurrency limit for the subscription.|
|monthlyChargeScheduleId|number|false|none|This is the ID of the monthly job that charges for subscription add ons and phone numbers.|
|monthlyCreditCheckScheduleId|number|false|none|This is the ID of the monthly job that checks whether the credit balance of the subscription<br>is sufficient for the monthly charge.|
|stripeCustomerId|string|false|none|This is the Stripe customer ID.|
|stripePaymentMethodId|string|false|none|This is the Stripe payment ID.|
|hipaaEnabled|boolean|false|none|This is the HIPAA enabled flag for the subscription. It determines whether orgs under this<br>subscription have the option to enable HIPAA compliance.|
|zdrEnabled|boolean|false|none|This is the ZDR enabled flag for the subscription. It determines whether orgs under this<br>subscription have the option to enable ZDR.|
|dataRetentionEnabled|boolean|false|none|This is the data retention enabled flag for the subscription. It determines whether orgs under this<br>subscription have the option to enable data retention.|
|hipaaCommonPaperAgreementId|string|false|none|This is the ID for the Common Paper agreement outlining the HIPAA contract.|
|stripePaymentMethodFingerprint|string|false|none|This is the Stripe fingerprint of the payment method (card). It allows us<br>to detect users who try to abuse our system through multiple sign-ups.|
|stripeCustomerEmail|string|false|none|This is the customer's email on Stripe.|
|referredByEmail|string|false|none|This is the email of the referrer for the subscription.|
|autoReloadPlan|object|false|none|This is the auto reload plan configured for the subscription.|
|minutesIncluded|number|false|none|The number of minutes included in the subscription.|
|minutesUsed|number|false|none|The number of minutes used in the subscription.|
|minutesUsedNextResetAt|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the timestamp at which the number of monthly free minutes is scheduled to reset at.|
|minutesOverageCost|number|false|none|The per minute charge on minutes that exceed the included minutes. Enterprise only.|
|providersIncluded|[string]|false|none|The list of providers included in the subscription. Enterprise only.|
|outboundCallsDailyLimit|number|false|none|The maximum number of outbound calls this subscription may make in a day. Resets every night.|
|outboundCallsCounter|number|false|none|The current number of outbound calls the subscription has made in the current day.|
|outboundCallsCounterNextResetAt|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the timestamp at which the outbound calls counter is scheduled to reset at.|
|couponIds|[string]|false|none|This is the IDs of the coupons applicable to this subscription.|
|couponUsageLeft|string|false|none|This is the number of credits left obtained from a coupon.|
|invoicePlan|object|false|none|This is the invoice plan for the subscription.|
|pciEnabled|boolean|false|none|This is the PCI enabled flag for the subscription. It determines whether orgs under this<br>subscription have the option to enable PCI compliance.|
|pciCommonPaperAgreementId|string|false|none|This is the ID for the Common Paper agreement outlining the PCI contract.|
|callRetentionDays|number \| null|false|none|This is the call retention days for the subscription.|
|chatRetentionDays|number \| null|false|none|This is the chat retention days for the subscription.|
|minutesIncludedResetFrequency|string|false|none|This is the minutes_included reset frequency for the subscription.|
|rbacEnabled|boolean|false|none|This is the Role Based Access Control (RBAC) enabled flag for the subscription.|
|platformFee|number|false|none|This is the platform fee for the subscription.|
|billingCollectionMethod|string \| null|false|none|This is how payment is collected for the subscription: charged to the card<br>on file, or invoiced.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|hipaaEnabled|boolean|false|none|When this is enabled, logs, recordings, and transcriptions will be stored in HIPAA-compliant storage. Defaults to false.<br>When HIPAA is enabled, only HIPAA-compliant providers will be available for LLM, Voice, and Transcriber respectively.<br>This is due to the compliance requirements of HIPAA. Other providers may not meet these requirements.|
|workosRepairPending|boolean|false|none|The org was created locally, but WorkOS access is still being repaired.<br>Clients should keep the current session/org and refresh the org list.|
|workosRepairQueued|boolean|false|none|Whether the pending WorkOS repair was accepted by Kafka.|
|subscription|[Subscription](#schemasubscription)|false|none|none|
|subscriptionId|string|false|none|This is the ID of the subscription the org belongs to.|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the org.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the org was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the org was last updated.|
|stripeSubscriptionId|string|false|none|This is the subscription for the org.|
|stripeSubscriptionItemId|string|false|none|This is the subscription's subscription item.|
|stripeSubscriptionCurrentPeriodStart|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the subscription's current period start.|
|stripeSubscriptionStatus|string|false|none|This is the subscription's status.|
|jwtSecret|string|false|none|This is the secret key used for signing JWT tokens for the org.|
|minutesUsed|number|false|none|This is the total number of call minutes used by this org across all time.|
|name|string|false|none|This is the name of the org. This is just for your own reference.|
|channel|string|false|none|This is the channel of the org. There is the cluster the API traffic for the org will be directed.|
|billingLimit|number|false|none|This is the monthly billing limit for the org. To go beyond $1000/mo, please contact us at support@vapi.ai.|
|server|object|false|none|This is where Vapi will send webhooks. You can find all webhooks available along with their shape in ServerMessage schema.<br><br>The order of precedence is:<br><br>1. assistant.server<br>2. phoneNumber.server<br>3. org.server|
|concurrencyLimit|number|false|none|**Deprecated.** This is the concurrency limit for the org. This is the maximum number of calls that can be active at any given time. To go beyond 10, please contact us at support@vapi.ai.|
|compliancePlan|object|false|none|Stores the information about the compliance plan enforced at the organization level. Currently pciEnabled is supported through this field.<br>When this is enabled, any logs, recordings, or transcriptions will be shipped to the customer endpoints if provided else lost.<br>At the end of the call, you will receive an end-of-call-report message to store on your server, if webhook is provided.<br>Defaults to false.<br>When PCI is enabled, only PCI-compliant Providers will be available for LLM, Voice and transcribers.<br>This is due to the compliance requirements of PCI. Other providers may not meet these requirements.|

<h2 id="tocS_OrgConcurrencyLimitsDTO">OrgConcurrencyLimitsDTO</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorgconcurrencylimitsdto"></a>
<a id="schema_OrgConcurrencyLimitsDTO"></a>
<a id="tocSorgconcurrencylimitsdto"></a>
<a id="tocsorgconcurrencylimitsdto"></a>

```json
{
  "concurrencyBlocked": true,
  "concurrencyLimit": 0,
  "remainingConcurrentCalls": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|concurrencyBlocked|boolean|true|none|True when the org is at or over its concurrency limit at the time of the read. This is a status read, not an admission decision: no call was evaluated and no slot is reserved.|
|concurrencyLimit|number|true|none|Maximum number of concurrent calls the subscription allows, at the time of the read. Computed as the subscription's included plus purchased concurrency, defaulting to the initial allowance when either is unset; call create derives its own figure and can differ for subscriptions with an unset allowance.|
|remainingConcurrentCalls|number|true|none|Plain concurrent-call headroom at the time of the read, floored at zero. Unlike the call create response, this does not include or reserve a slot for a new call.|

<h2 id="tocS_OrgApiLimitsDTO">OrgApiLimitsDTO</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorgapilimitsdto"></a>
<a id="schema_OrgApiLimitsDTO"></a>
<a id="tocSorgapilimitsdto"></a>
<a id="tocsorgapilimitsdto"></a>

```json
{
  "rateLimitUsage": 0,
  "rateLimitMax": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rateLimitUsage|number|true|none|Approximate number of API requests counted against the rate limit in the current minute, in the region that served this request. The count lives in a tumbling one-minute window aligned to the UTC clock (unix seconds / 60), so it resets to zero at the top of every minute; there is no reset header — the next boundary is (floor(now / 60) + 1) * 60.|
|rateLimitMax|number|true|none|Maximum number of standard API requests allowed per minute, in the region that served this request. Live call media traffic is limited separately and is not reflected here.|

<h2 id="tocS_OrgLimitsResponseDTO">OrgLimitsResponseDTO</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorglimitsresponsedto"></a>
<a id="schema_OrgLimitsResponseDTO"></a>
<a id="tocSorglimitsresponsedto"></a>
<a id="tocsorglimitsresponsedto"></a>

```json
{
  "subscriptionLimits": {
    "concurrencyBlocked": true,
    "concurrencyLimit": 0,
    "remainingConcurrentCalls": 0
  },
  "apiLimits": {
    "rateLimitUsage": 0,
    "rateLimitMax": 0
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriptionLimits|object|false|none|Call concurrency limits for the subscription. Unlike the call create response, remainingConcurrentCalls does not reserve a slot for a new call: it is the plain headroom at the time of the read. Covers the concurrency gate only — credits, frozen subscriptions, included minutes, and the billing limit are not reflected here, so call create can still refuse. Omitted when the limits could not be computed, and for an org with no subscription at all (legacy ungated orgs), which has no concurrency ceiling.|
|apiLimits|object|false|none|API rate limit usage for the org. Approximate, per region, and scoped to the current minute. Omitted when the limit information is unavailable.|

<h2 id="tocS_UserWithRole">UserWithRole</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemauserwithrole"></a>
<a id="schema_UserWithRole"></a>
<a id="tocSuserwithrole"></a>
<a id="tocsuserwithrole"></a>

```json
{
  "role": "admin",
  "lastActiveAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "id": "string",
  "createdAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "email": "string",
  "fullName": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|role|string|true|none|This is the user's role in the org: a built-in role, the HIPAA special role, or a custom WorkOS role slug prefixed with `org-`.|
|lastActiveAt|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of the user's most recent sign-in to the org's identity provider (WorkOS). It is a property of the user, not of this org membership, so a sign-in to another WorkOS org counts. Only returned to org admins; absent when the requester is not an admin, no sign-in has been recorded, or the org is not linked to WorkOS.|
|id|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the profile or user.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the profile was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the profile was last updated.|
|email|string|true|none|This is the email of the user that is associated with the profile.|
|fullName|string|false|none|This is the full name of the user that is associated with the profile.|

<h2 id="tocS_TokenRestrictions">TokenRestrictions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schematokenrestrictions"></a>
<a id="schema_TokenRestrictions"></a>
<a id="tocStokenrestrictions"></a>
<a id="tocstokenrestrictions"></a>

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "allowedOrigins": [
    "string"
  ],
  "allowedAssistantIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "allowTransientAssistant": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enabled|boolean|false|none|This determines whether the token is enabled or disabled. Default is true, it's enabled.|
|allowedOrigins|[string]|false|none|This determines the allowed origins for this token. Validates the `Origin` header. Default is any origin.<br><br>Only relevant for `public` tokens.|
|allowedAssistantIds|[string]|false|none|This determines which assistantIds can be used when creating a call. Default is any assistantId.<br><br>Only relevant for `public` tokens.|
|allowTransientAssistant|boolean|false|none|This determines whether transient assistants can be used when creating a call. Default is true.<br><br>If `allowedAssistantIds` is provided, this is automatically false.<br><br>Only relevant for `public` tokens.|

|files|[string(binary)]|true|none|Reference audio to clone the voice from (up to 120 seconds). Supported formats: MP3, WAV, OGG/Opus, WebM, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WMA.|

<h2 id="tocS_TimeRange">TimeRange</h2>

<a id="tocstimerange"></a>

```json
{
  "step": "second",
  "start": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "end": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "timezone": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|step|string|false|none|This is the time step for aggregations.<br><br>If not provided, defaults to returning for the entire time range.|
|start|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the start date for the time range.<br><br>If not provided, defaults to the 7 days ago.|
|end|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the end date for the time range.<br><br>If not provided, defaults to now.|
|timezone|string|false|none|This is the timezone you want to set for the query.<br><br>If not provided, defaults to UTC.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|step|second|
|step|minute|
|step|hour|
|step|day|
|step|week|
|step|month|
|step|quarter|
|step|year|
|step|decade|
|step|century|
|step|millennium|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "workflow.node.started" is sent when the active node changes.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|node|object|true|none|This is the active node.|

|---|---|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "assistant.started" is sent when the assistant is started.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|newAssistant|object|true|none|This is the assistant that was updated.|

|---|---|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "conversation-update" is sent when an update is committed to the conversation history.|
|messages|[[UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [BotMessage](#schemabotmessage) \| [ToolCallMessage](#schematoolcallmessage) \| [ToolCallResultMessage](#schematoolcallresultmessage)]|false|none|This is the most up-to-date conversation history at the time the message is sent.|
|messagesOpenAIFormatted|[[OpenAIMessage](#schemaopenaimessage)]|true|none|This is the most up-to-date conversation history at the time the message is sent, formatted for OpenAI.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|conversation-update|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "hang" is sent when the assistant is hanging due to a delay. The delay can be caused by many factors, such as:<br>- the model is too slow to respond<br>- the voice is too slow to respond<br>- the tool call is still waiting for a response from your server<br>- etc.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|hang|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "metadata" is sent to forward metadata to the client.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|metadata|string|true|none|This is the metadata content|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "model-output" is sent as the model outputs tokens.|
|turnId|string|false|none|This is the unique identifier for the current LLM turn. All tokens from the same<br>LLM response share the same turnId. Use this to group tokens and discard on interruption.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|output|object|true|none|This is the output of the model. It can be a token or tool call.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|model-output|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "speech-update" is sent whenever assistant or user start or stop speaking.|
|status|string|true|none|This is the status of the speech update.|
|role|string|true|none|This is the role which the speech update is for.|
|turn|number|false|none|This is the turn number of the speech update (0-indexed).|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|speech-update|
|status|started|
|status|stopped|
|role|assistant|
|role|user|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "transcript" is sent as transcriber outputs partial or final transcript.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|role|string|true|none|This is the role for which the transcript is for.|
|transcriptType|string|true|none|This is the type of the transcript.|
|transcript|string|true|none|This is the transcript content.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|The ID of the assistant that produced this transcript. Present on<br>assistant-role events when an active assistant ID is available.|
|assistantName|string|false|none|The name of the assistant that produced this transcript. Present on<br>assistant-role events when an active assistant name is available.|
|isFiltered|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the transcript was filtered for security reasons.|
|detectedThreats|[string]|false|none|List of detected security threats if the transcript was filtered.|
|originalTranscript|string|false|none|The original transcript before filtering (only included if content was filtered).|
|confidence|number|false|none|The transcriber's confidence score for this transcript, in [0, 1]. Only<br>ever set alongside `confidenceSource` — see there for why an unmarked<br>score is never included. Set only on final user-role transcripts: each<br>live message carries the score of the one fragment it was built from, and<br>`artifact.messages` agrees with it per fragment. A stored message built<br>from several consecutive fragments reports the minimum across them as<br>'derived', so it can differ from the individual live messages that fed<br>it. Partials never carry a score, because nothing stored exists for a<br>partial's score to agree with.|
|confidenceSource|string|false|none|Whether `confidence` came directly from the transcriber ('provider') or<br>was computed by Vapi ('derived').<br><br>'derived' means Vapi computed the score from the transcriber's per-word<br>scores; the exact aggregation is provider-specific (an average, a median<br>or a minimum, depending on the transcriber).<br><br>Absent means no trustworthy score was available for this transcript:<br>either the transcriber does not report one, or the value it reported was<br>invalid and was dropped.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|transcript|
|type|transcript[transcriptType="final"]|
|role|assistant|
|role|user|
|transcriptType|partial|
|transcriptType|final|
|confidenceSource|provider|
|confidenceSource|derived|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|false|none|This is the type of the message. "tool-calls" is sent to call a tool.|
|toolWithToolCallList|[[FunctionToolWithToolCall](#schemafunctiontoolwithtoolcall) \| [GhlToolWithToolCall](#schemaghltoolwithtoolcall) \| [MakeToolWithToolCall](#schemamaketoolwithtoolcall) \| [BashToolWithToolCall](#schemabashtoolwithtoolcall) \| [ComputerToolWithToolCall](#schemacomputertoolwithtoolcall) \| [TextEditorToolWithToolCall](#schematexteditortoolwithtoolcall) \| [GoogleCalendarCreateEventToolWithToolCall](#schemagooglecalendarcreateeventtoolwithtoolcall)]|true|none|This is the list of tools calls that the model is requesting along with the original tool configuration.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|toolCallList|[[ToolCall](#schematoolcall)]|true|none|This is the list of tool calls that the model is requesting.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "tool-calls-result" is sent to forward the result of a tool call to the client.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|toolCallResult|object|true|none|This is the result of the tool call.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|tool-calls-result|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "transfer-update" is sent whenever a transfer happens.|
|destination|[TransferDestinationAssistant](#schematransferdestinationassistant) \| [TransferDestinationNumber](#schematransferdestinationnumber) \| [TransferDestinationSip](#schematransferdestinationsip)|false|none|This is the destination of the transfer.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|toAssistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the call is being transferred to. This is only sent if `destination.type` is "assistant".|
|fromAssistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the call is being transferred from. This is only sent if `destination.type` is "assistant".|
|toStepRecord|object|false|none|This is the step that the conversation moved to.|
|fromStepRecord|object|false|none|This is the step that the conversation moved from. =|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|transfer-update|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "user-interrupted" is sent when the user interrupts the assistant.|
|turnId|string|false|none|This is the turnId of the LLM response that was interrupted. Matches the turnId<br>on model-output messages so clients can discard the interrupted turn's tokens.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|user-interrupted|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "language-change-detected" is sent when the transcriber is automatically switched based on the detected language.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|language|string|true|none|This is the language the transcriber is switched to.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|language-change-detected|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "voice-input" is sent when a generation is requested from voice provider.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|input|string|true|none|This is the voice input content|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|voice-input|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "assistant-speech" is sent as assistant audio is being played.|
|text|string|true|none|The full assistant text for the current turn. This is the complete text,<br>not an incremental delta — consumers should use `timing` metadata (e.g.<br>`wordsSpoken`) to determine which portion has been spoken so far.|
|turn|number|false|none|This is the turn number of the assistant speech event (0-indexed).|
|source|string|false|none|Indicates how the text was sourced.|
|timing|[AssistantSpeechWordAlignmentTiming](#schemaassistantspeechwordalignmenttiming) \| [AssistantSpeechWordProgressTiming](#schemaassistantspeechwordprogresstiming)|false|none|Optional timing metadata. Shape depends on `timing.type`:<br><br>- `word-alignment` (ElevenLabs): per-character timing at playback<br>  cadence. words[] includes space entries. Best consumed by tracking<br>  a running character count: join timing.words, add to a char cursor,<br>  and highlight text up to that position. No interpolation needed.<br><br>- `word-progress` (Minimax with voice.subtitleType: 'word'): cursor-<br>  based word count per TTS segment. Use wordsSpoken as the anchor,<br>  interpolate forward using segmentDurationMs or timing.words until<br>  the next event arrives.<br><br>When absent, the event is a text-only fallback for providers without<br>word-level timing (e.g. Cartesia, Deepgram, Azure). Text emits once<br>per TTS chunk when audio is playing. Optionally interpolate a word<br>cursor at ~3.5 words/sec between events for approximate tracking.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|assistant.speechStarted|
|source|model|
|source|force-say|
|source|custom-voice|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "chat.created" is sent when a new chat is created.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|true|none|This is the chat that was created.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|chat.created|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "chat.deleted" is sent when a chat is deleted.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|true|none|This is the chat that was deleted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|chat.deleted|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "session.created" is sent when a new session is created.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|session|object|true|none|This is the session that was created.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|session.created|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "session.updated" is sent when a session is updated.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|session|object|true|none|This is the session that was updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|session.updated|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "session.deleted" is sent when a session is deleted.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|session|object|true|none|This is the session that was deleted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|session.deleted|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "call.deleted" is sent when a call is deleted.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "call.deleted" is sent when a call is deleted.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "assistant-request" is sent to fetch assistant configuration for an incoming call.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|assistant-request|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "conversation-update" is sent when an update is committed to the conversation history.|
|messages|[[UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [BotMessage](#schemabotmessage) \| [ToolCallMessage](#schematoolcallmessage) \| [ToolCallResultMessage](#schematoolcallresultmessage)]|false|none|This is the most up-to-date conversation history at the time the message is sent.|
|messagesOpenAIFormatted|[[OpenAIMessage](#schemaopenaimessage)]|true|none|This is the most up-to-date conversation history at the time the message is sent, formatted for OpenAI.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|conversation-update|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "end-of-call-report" is sent when the call ends and post-processing is complete.|
|endedReason|string|true|none|This is the reason the call ended. This can also be found at `call.endedReason` on GET /call/:id.|
|cost|number|false|none|This is the cost of the call in USD. This can also be found at `call.cost` on GET /call/:id.|
|costs|[[TransportCost](#schematransportcost) \| [TranscriberCost](#schematranscribercost) \| [ModelCost](#schemamodelcost) \| [VoiceCost](#schemavoicecost) \| [VapiCost](#schemavapicost) \| [VoicemailDetectionCost](#schemavoicemaildetectioncost) \| [AnalysisCost](#schemaanalysiscost) \| [KnowledgeBaseCost](#schemaknowledgebasecost)]|false|none|These are the costs of individual components of the call in USD. This can also be found at `call.costs` on GET /call/:id.|
|destination|[TransferDestinationNumber](#schematransferdestinationnumber) \| [TransferDestinationSip](#schematransferdestinationsip)|false|none|This is the destination the call was transferred to, if the call was forwarded.<br>This can also be found at `call.destination` on GET /call/:id.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|true|none|These are the artifacts from the call. This can also be found at `call.artifact` on GET /call/:id.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|analysis|object|true|none|This is the analysis of the call. This can also be found at `call.analysis` on GET /call/:id.|
|startedAt|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the call started. This can also be found at `call.startedAt` on GET /call/:id.|
|endedAt|string(date-time)|false|none|This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the call ended. This can also be found at `call.endedAt` on GET /call/:id.|
|compliance|object|false|none|This is the compliance result of the call. This can also be found at `call.compliance` on GET /call/:id.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "handoff-destination-request" is sent when the model is requesting handoff but destination is unknown.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|parameters|object|true|none|This is the parameters of the handoff destination request.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|handoff-destination-request|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "hang" is sent when the assistant is hanging due to a delay. The delay can be caused by many factors, such as:<br>- the model is too slow to respond<br>- the voice is too slow to respond<br>- the tool call is still waiting for a response from your server<br>- etc.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|hang|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "knowledge-base-request" is sent to request knowledge base documents. To enable, use `assistant.knowledgeBase.provider=custom-knowledge-base`.|
|messages|[[UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [BotMessage](#schemabotmessage) \| [ToolCallMessage](#schematoolcallmessage) \| [ToolCallResultMessage](#schematoolcallresultmessage)]|false|none|These are the messages that are going to be sent to the `model` right after the `knowledge-base-request` webhook completes.|
|messagesOpenAIFormatted|[[OpenAIMessage](#schemaopenaimessage)]|true|none|This is just `messages` formatted for OpenAI.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "model-output" is sent as the model outputs tokens.|
|turnId|string|false|none|This is the unique identifier for the current LLM turn. All tokens from the same<br>LLM response share the same turnId. Use this to group tokens and discard on interruption.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|output|object|true|none|This is the output of the model. It can be a token or tool call.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|model-output|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "phone-call-control" is an advanced type of message.<br><br>When it is requested in `assistant.serverMessages`, the hangup and forwarding responsibilities are delegated to your server. Vapi will no longer do the actual transfer and hangup.|
|request|string|true|none|This is the request to control the phone call.|
|destination|[TransferDestinationNumber](#schematransferdestinationnumber) \| [TransferDestinationSip](#schematransferdestinationsip)|false|none|This is the destination to forward the call to if the request is "forward".|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|phone-call-control|
|request|forward|
|request|hang-up|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "speech-update" is sent whenever assistant or user start or stop speaking.|
|status|string|true|none|This is the status of the speech update.|
|role|string|true|none|This is the role which the speech update is for.|
|turn|number|false|none|This is the turn number of the speech update (0-indexed).|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|speech-update|
|status|started|
|status|stopped|
|role|assistant|
|role|user|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "status-update" is sent whenever the `call.status` changes.|
|status|string|true|none|This is the status of the call.|
|endedReason|string|false|none|This is the reason the call ended. This is only sent if the status is "ended".|
|messages|[[UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [BotMessage](#schemabotmessage) \| [ToolCallMessage](#schematoolcallmessage) \| [ToolCallResultMessage](#schematoolcallresultmessage)]|false|none|These are the conversation messages of the call. This is only sent if the status is "forwarding".|
|messagesOpenAIFormatted|[[OpenAIMessage](#schemaopenaimessage)]|false|none|These are the conversation messages of the call. This is only sent if the status is "forwarding".|
|destination|[TransferDestinationNumber](#schematransferdestinationnumber) \| [TransferDestinationSip](#schematransferdestinationsip)|false|none|This is the destination the call is being transferred to. This is only sent if the status is "forwarding".|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|transcript|string|false|none|This is the transcript of the call. This is only sent if the status is "forwarding".|
|summary|string|false|none|This is the summary of the call. This is only sent if the status is "forwarding".|
|inboundPhoneCallDebuggingArtifacts|object|false|none|This is the inbound phone call debugging artifacts. This is only sent if the status is "ended" and there was an error accepting the inbound phone call.<br><br>This will include any errors related to the "assistant-request" if one was made.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|false|none|This is the type of the message. "tool-calls" is sent to call a tool.|
|toolWithToolCallList|[[FunctionToolWithToolCall](#schemafunctiontoolwithtoolcall) \| [GhlToolWithToolCall](#schemaghltoolwithtoolcall) \| [MakeToolWithToolCall](#schemamaketoolwithtoolcall) \| [BashToolWithToolCall](#schemabashtoolwithtoolcall) \| [ComputerToolWithToolCall](#schemacomputertoolwithtoolcall) \| [TextEditorToolWithToolCall](#schematexteditortoolwithtoolcall) \| [GoogleCalendarCreateEventToolWithToolCall](#schemagooglecalendarcreateeventtoolwithtoolcall)]|true|none|This is the list of tools calls that the model is requesting along with the original tool configuration.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|toolCallList|[[ToolCall](#schematoolcall)]|true|none|This is the list of tool calls that the model is requesting.|

|---|---|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "transfer-destination-request" is sent when the model is requesting transfer but destination is unknown.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|transfer-destination-request|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "transfer-update" is sent whenever a transfer happens.|
|destination|[TransferDestinationAssistant](#schematransferdestinationassistant) \| [TransferDestinationNumber](#schematransferdestinationnumber) \| [TransferDestinationSip](#schematransferdestinationsip)|false|none|This is the destination of the transfer.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|toAssistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the call is being transferred to. This is only sent if `destination.type` is "assistant".|
|fromAssistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the call is being transferred from. This is only sent if `destination.type` is "assistant".|
|toStepRecord|object|false|none|This is the step that the conversation moved to.|
|fromStepRecord|object|false|none|This is the step that the conversation moved from. =|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
