### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "transcript" is sent as transcriber outputs partial or final transcript.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|role|string|true|none|This is the role for which the transcript is for.|
|transcriptType|string|true|none|This is the type of the transcript.|
|transcript|string|true|none|This is the transcript content.|
|assistantId|string|false|none|The ID of the assistant that produced this transcript. Present on<br>assistant-role events when an active assistant ID is available.|
|assistantName|string|false|none|The name of the assistant that produced this transcript. Present on<br>assistant-role events when an active assistant name is available.|
|isFiltered|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the transcript was filtered for security reasons.|
|detectedThreats|[string]|false|none|List of detected security threats if the transcript was filtered.|
|originalTranscript|string|false|none|The original transcript before filtering (only included if content was filtered).|
|confidence|number|false|none|The transcriber's confidence score for this transcript, in [0, 1]. Only<br>ever set alongside `confidenceSource` — see there for why an unmarked<br>score is never included. Set only on final user-role transcripts: each<br>live message carries the score of the one fragment it was built from, and<br>`artifact.messages` agrees with it per fragment. A stored message built<br>from several consecutive fragments reports the minimum across them as<br>'derived', so it can differ from the individual live messages that fed<br>it. Partials never carry a score, because nothing stored exists for a<br>partial's score to agree with.|
|confidenceSource|string|false|none|Whether `confidence` came directly from the transcriber ('provider') or<br>was computed by Vapi ('derived').<br><br>'derived' means Vapi computed the score from the transcriber's per-word<br>scores; the exact aggregation is provider-specific (an average, a median<br>or a minimum, depending on the transcriber).<br><br>Absent means no trustworthy score was available for this transcript:<br>either the transcriber does not report one, or the value it reported was<br>invalid and was dropped.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|transcript|
|type|transcript[transcriptType="final"]|
|role|assistant|
|role|user|
|transcriptType|partial|
|transcriptType|final|
|confidenceSource|provider|
|confidenceSource|derived|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "user-interrupted" is sent when the user interrupts the assistant.|
|turnId|string|false|none|This is the turnId of the LLM response that was interrupted. Matches the turnId<br>on model-output messages so clients can discard the interrupted turn's tokens.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|user-interrupted|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "language-change-detected" is sent when the transcriber is automatically switched based on the detected language.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|language|string|true|none|This is the language the transcriber is switched to.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|language-change-detected|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "voice-input" is sent when a generation is requested from voice provider.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|input|string|true|none|This is the voice input content|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|voice-input|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "assistant-speech" is sent as assistant audio is being played.|
|text|string|true|none|The full assistant text for the current turn. This is the complete text,<br>not an incremental delta — consumers should use `timing` metadata (e.g.<br>`wordsSpoken`) to determine which portion has been spoken so far.|
|turn|number|false|none|This is the turn number of the assistant speech event (0-indexed).|
|source|string|false|none|Indicates how the text was sourced.|
|timing|[AssistantSpeechWordAlignmentTiming](#schemaassistantspeechwordalignmenttiming) \| [AssistantSpeechWordProgressTiming](#schemaassistantspeechwordprogresstiming)|false|none|Optional timing metadata. Shape depends on `timing.type`:<br><br>- `word-alignment` (ElevenLabs): per-character timing at playback<br>  cadence. words[] includes space entries. Best consumed by tracking<br>  a running character count: join timing.words, add to a char cursor,<br>  and highlight text up to that position. No interpolation needed.<br><br>- `word-progress` (Minimax with voice.subtitleType: 'word'): cursor-<br>  based word count per TTS segment. Use wordsSpoken as the anchor,<br>  interpolate forward using segmentDurationMs or timing.words until<br>  the next event arrives.<br><br>When absent, the event is a text-only fallback for providers without<br>word-level timing (e.g. Cartesia, Deepgram, Azure). Text emits once<br>per TTS chunk when audio is playing. Optionally interpolate a word<br>cursor at ~3.5 words/sec between events for approximate tracking.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|assistant.speechStarted|
|source|model|
|source|force-say|
|source|custom-voice|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "voice-request" is sent when using `assistant.voice={ "type": "custom-voice" }`.<br><br>Here is what the request will look like:<br><br>POST https://{assistant.voice.server.url}<br>Content-Type: application/json<br><br>{<br>  "messsage": {<br>    "type": "voice-request",<br>    "text": "Hello, world!",<br>    "sampleRate": 24000,<br>    ...other metadata about the call...<br>  }<br>}<br><br>The expected response is 1-channel 16-bit raw PCM audio at the sample rate specified in the request. Here is how the response will be piped to the transport:<br>```<br>response.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {<br>  outputStream.write(chunk);<br>});<br>```|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|text|string|true|none|This is the text to be synthesized.|
|sampleRate|number|true|none|This is the sample rate to be synthesized.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|voice-request|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "call.endpointing.request" is sent when using `assistant.startSpeakingPlan.smartEndpointingPlan={ "provider": "custom-endpointing-model" }`.<br><br>Here is what the request will look like:<br><br>POST https://{assistant.startSpeakingPlan.smartEndpointingPlan.server.url}<br>Content-Type: application/json<br><br>{<br>  "message": {<br>    "type": "call.endpointing.request",<br>    "messages": [<br>      {<br>        "role": "user",<br>        "message": "Hello, how are you?",<br>        "time": 1234567890,<br>        "secondsFromStart": 0<br>      }<br>    ],<br>    ...other metadata about the call...<br>  }<br>}<br><br>The expected response:<br>{<br>  "timeoutSeconds": 0.5<br>}|
|messages|[[UserMessage](#schemausermessage) \| [SystemMessage](#schemasystemmessage) \| [BotMessage](#schemabotmessage) \| [ToolCallMessage](#schematoolcallmessage) \| [ToolCallResultMessage](#schematoolcallresultmessage)]|false|none|This is the conversation history at the time of the endpointing request.|
|messagesOpenAIFormatted|[[OpenAIMessage](#schemaopenaimessage)]|true|none|This is just `messages` formatted for OpenAI.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "chat.created" is sent when a new chat is created.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|true|none|This is the chat that was created.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|chat.created|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "chat.deleted" is sent when a chat is deleted.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|true|none|This is the chat that was deleted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|chat.deleted|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "session.created" is sent when a new session is created.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|session|object|true|none|This is the session that was created.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|session.created|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "session.updated" is sent when a session is updated.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|session|object|true|none|This is the session that was updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|session.updated|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "session.deleted" is sent when a session is deleted.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|
|session|object|true|none|This is the session that was deleted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|session.deleted|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "call.deleted" is sent when a call is deleted.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|call.deleted|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "call.deleted" is sent when a call is deleted.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|call.delete.failed|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "call.artifact.upload" is sent after a call<br>to report whether each artifact was stored in your own configured storage.|
|artifacts|[[CallArtifactUploadItem](#schemacallartifactuploaditem)]|true|none|One entry per artifact whose write targeted your own configured storage,<br>each reporting whether that artifact was stored successfully. Artifacts that<br>were not destined for your own storage (Vapi default storage, or no storage<br>credential configured) are omitted, and this message is sent only when at<br>least one artifact targeted your own storage.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|call.artifact.upload|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneNumber|[CreateByoPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatebyophonenumberdto) \| [CreateTwilioPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetwiliophonenumberdto) \| [CreateVonagePhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevonagephonenumberdto) \| [CreateVapiPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatevapiphonenumberdto) \| [CreateTelnyxPhoneNumberDTO](#schemacreatetelnyxphonenumberdto)|false|none|This is the phone number that the message is associated with.|
|assistantVersion|string \| null|false|none|This is the version label (e.g. `v3`) of the assistant the call was<br>configured with. `null` for inline assistants, squad/workflow calls,<br>pre-resolution assistant-request messages, and orgs not on<br>assistant versioning.|
|type|string|true|none|This is the type of the message. "campaign.predial" is sent to the campaign's server before each contact is dialed, so the server can decide whether the contact is eligible to be called. It is only sent when the campaign's `predialPlan` is set (and not disabled).|
|campaignId|string|true|none|This is the ID of the campaign the contact belongs to.|
|contact|object|true|none|This is the contact that is about to be dialed.|
|timestamp|number|false|none|This is the timestamp of the message.|
|artifact|object|false|none|This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.<br><br>This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that the message is associated with.|
|customer|object|false|none|This is the customer that the message is associated with.|
|call|object|false|none|This is the call that the message is associated with.|
|chat|object|false|none|This is the chat object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|campaign.predial|

To use a transient assistant, use `assistant` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistantId` or `assistant`<br>- Squad, use `squadId` or `squad`<br>- Workflow, use `workflowId` or `workflow`|
|assistant|object|false|none|This is the assistant that will be used for the call. To use an existing assistant, use `assistantId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant`<br>- Squad, use `squad`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow`|
|assistantOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `assistant` or `assistantId`'s settings and template variables.|
|squadId|string|false|none|This is the squad that will be used for the call. To use a transient squad, use `squad` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|squad|object|false|none|This is a squad that will be used for the call. To use an existing squad, use `squadId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|squadOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `squad` or `squadId`'s member settings and template variables.<br>This will apply to all members of the squad.|
|workflowId|string|false|none|This is the workflow that will be used for the call. To use a transient workflow, use `workflow` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|workflow|object|false|none|This is a workflow that will be used for the call. To use an existing workflow, use `workflowId` instead.<br><br>To start a call with:<br>- Assistant, use `assistant` or `assistantId`<br>- Squad, use `squad` or `squadId`<br>- Workflow, use `workflow` or `workflowId`|
|workflowOverrides|object|false|none|These are the overrides for the `workflow` or `workflowId`'s settings and template variables.|
|error|string|false|none|This is the error if the call shouldn't be accepted. This is spoken to the customer.<br><br>If this is sent, `assistantId`, `assistant`, `squadId`, `squad`, and `destination` are ignored.|

```json
      {
        "operator": "eq",
        "param": "string",
        "value": "string"
      }
    ]
  },

  "toolCallId": "string",
  "result": "string",
  "error": "string",
  "metadata": {}
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|message|[ToolMessageComplete](#schematoolmessagecomplete) \| [ToolMessageFailed](#schematoolmessagefailed)|false|none|This is the message that will be spoken to the user.<br><br>If this is not returned, assistant will speak:<br>1. a `request-complete` or `request-failed` message from `tool.messages`, if it exists<br>2. a response generated by the model, if not|
|name|string|true|none|This is the name of the function the model called.|
|toolCallId|string|true|none|This is the unique identifier for the tool call.|
|result|string|false|none|This is the result if the tool call was successful. This is added to the conversation history.<br><br>Further, if this is returned, assistant will speak:<br>1. the `message`, if it exists and is of type `request-complete`<br>2. a `request-complete` message from `tool.messages`, if it exists<br>3. a response generated by the model, if neither exist|
|error|string|false|none|This is the error if the tool call was not successful. This is added to the conversation history.<br><br>Further, if this is returned, assistant will speak:<br>1. the `message`, if it exists and is of type `request-failed`<br>2. a `request-failed` message from `tool.messages`, if it exists<br>3. a response generated by the model, if neither exist|
|metadata|object|false|none|This is optional metadata for the tool call result to be sent to the client.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

Follow these instructions:<br><br>Here is what the request will look like:<br><br>POST https://{assistant.voice.server.url}<br>Content-Type: application/json<br><br>{<br>  "messsage": {<br>    "type": "voice-request",<br>    "text": "Hello, world!",<br>    "sampleRate": 24000,<br>    ...other metadata about the call...<br>  }<br>}<br><br>The expected response is 1-channel 16-bit raw PCM audio at the sample rate specified in the request. Here is how the response will be piped to the transport:<br>```<br>response.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {<br>  outputStream.write(chunk);<br>});<br>```|
